Citi's mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We have 200 years of experience helping our clients meet the world's toughest challenges and embrace its greatest opportunities.
  
  
**Citi Analytics and Information Management (AIM)**
Citi AIM was established in 2003 and is located across multiple cities in India - Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram and Pune. It is a global community that objectively connects and analyzes information, to create actionable intelligence for our business leaders. It identifies fact-based opportunities for revenue growth in partnership with the businesses. The function balances customer needs, business strategy, and profit objectives using best in class and relevant analytic methodologies.
  
  
**What we do?**
The US Consumer Cards (USCC) – Digital Product Analytics Team is a specialized function dedicated to understanding, measuring, and improving the servicing and marketing experience across all digital platforms. We are a dynamic and data-driven team focused on accelerating digital growth, enhancing customer engagement, and driving operational efficiency. By leveraging cutting-edge analytics and Gen-AI, we identify and act on opportunities to improve the customer lifecycle, increase digital revenue, and reduce service costs. We foster a culture of continuous learning and rapid experimentation to deliver impactful digital experiences that resonate with our customers. Our mission is to leverage data and insights to make our digital platforms the preferred channels for our customers, ultimately driving revenue and efficiency.
  
  
**Role Description:**
The Business Analytics Analyst (C10) is a developing professional role. Deals with most problems independently and has some latitude to solve complex problems. Integrates in-depth specialty area knowledge with a solid understanding of industry standards and practices. Applies analytical thinking and knowledge of data analysis tools and methodologies. Requires attention to detail when making judgments and recommendations based on the analysis of factual information. Typically deals with variable issues with potentially broader business impact. Applies professional judgment when interpreting data and results. Breaks down information in a systematic and communicable manner. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required to exchange potentially complex/sensitive information. Moderate but direct impact through close contact with the businesses' core activities. * Drive Digital Marketing, Product Sales & Engagement:

+ Analyze user behavior and campaign performance to identify new opportunities for engagement and revenue generation.

+ Use analytical intelligence to uncover deep insights that inform strategies for reducing our cost-to-serve and improving overall efficiency across the customer lifecycle.

+ Lead the industrialization and enhancement of our "Test & Learn" capability, enabling the rapid design, execution, and measurement of experiments for new digital features and marketing campaigns.
+ Utilize A/B testing, multivariate testing, and other experimentation techniques to generate actionable insights and drive continuous improvement.

**Responsibilities:**

+ Interpret complex data sets to identify significant trends, patterns, and anomalies, translating these into clear, concise, and impactful insights that support informed decision-making for business partners and senior leadership.

+ Familiarity with GenAI governance principles and best practices to ensure responsible and compliant AI development.
+ Writing clean, efficient, and well-documented code according to design specifications and coding standards.
+ Knowledge of digital marketing and Credit Card business, and industry best practices is highly beneficial.
+ Experience working and collaborating with multiple stakeholders.
+ Ability to guide and mentor the junior team members. Ability to build partnerships with cross-functional teams.

+ Bachelor's Degree with at least 3 years of working experience OR Master's Degree with 2 years of working experience.

+ Hands-on experience working with large, complex, unstructured dataset, data warehouses and ability to pull data using relevant programs and coding.
+ Experience in working on Investment Analytics, Retail Analytics, Credit Cards, Services, Banking & Markets Financial Services be nice to have.
+ Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, be organized, detail oriented, flexible, and adaptive to matrix work environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

+ Experience in Python, PySpark, Hive, Impala, SQL programing will be preferred.
+ Credit card Business and P&L experience would be preferred.

title: AI Engineer, Harness & Eval
description:
You'll be one of the first engineers in NAVEX's AI Centre of Excellence, a new function with a company-wide mandate to put AI into how the business runs. We build AI for business operations and internal agentic products.

You'll build production agents and, more importantly, the harness around them: the evals, tracing and guardrails that tell us an agent works before a user finds out it doesn't. Some agents you'll build from scratch. Others were built by external partners and are moving in-house. You'll own both.

**At NAVEX, we’re transforming the world-making it safer, more ethical, and ensuring every voice is heard. That’s real impact.**

Our high-performance culture is driven by our values. We move with speed, passion and purpose - as one team. We are bold in our ideas, accountable in our actions, and committed to doing the right things right.

**You’ll thrive in this hybrid role surrounded by an engaged, collaborative team deeply committed to innovation, speed, and measurable outcomes. Join us and help shape what’s next!**

**What you’ll get:**

* **Meaningful Purpose.**
  Your work helps organizations operate with integrity and protect their people-at a scale few companies can match.
* **High-Performance Environment.**
  We move with urgency, set ambitious goals, and expect excellence. You’ll be trusted with real ownership and supported to do the best work of your career.
* **Candid, Supportive Culture.**
  We communicate openly, challenge ideas- not people-and value teammates who embrace bold thinking and continuous improvement.
* **Growth That Matters.**
  You can count on authentic feedback, strong accountability, and leaders invested in your success so you can achieve real growth.
* **Rewards for Results.**
  We provide clear, competitive compensation designed to recognize measurable outcomes and real impact.

**What you’ll do:**

* Build and ship agents for business operations and internal products. End to end: retrieval, tool use, orchestration, state, and handoffs to human
* Build MCP servers and tool integrations that give agents safe, reliable access to company systems and data
* Design the eval harness. Golden sets, regression suites, LLM-as-judge where it earns its place, human review loops. Every change ships with evidence that it made things better
* Instrument agents in production. Tracing, failure taxonomies, cost and latency tracking. When something degrades, you find out first and know why
* Take over agents built by external partners. Read the code, find where it breaks, add the evals and observability it shipped without
* Hold a verification bar. In a compliance company, an answer we can't source or explain doesn't ship

**What you’ll bring:**

* 3+ years of AI engineering experience, most of it building LLM systems that real users depend on
* Hands-on experience building with agentic harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar
* You've built MCP servers, eval harnesses or LLM Systems, not just used them and can explain how you knew a change was an improvement
* You've owned a system that degraded in production and diagnosed why, and can walk us through it
* Strong Python. Comfortable with at least one agent framework, and willing to go below it when it gets in the way
* Experience deploying on a major cloud provider: AWS, GCP or Azure
* You've shipped end-to-end and own outcomes, not just tasks
* You can take a non-technical team's workflow and turn it into a working system
* Bonus points for:
* Building RAG over messy enterprise documents—proposals, contracts and policies
* Working with AWS Bedrock or inside VPC-constrained enterprise environments
* Building in regulated or compliance-heavy domains
* Sharing your work through writing, talks or open source
* **Culture Agility.**
  Comfort working in a fast-paced, candid environment that values innovation, healthy debate, and follow-through
* **Fuel performance and outcomes.**
  Leverage your job competencies and champion NAVEX’s core values

**Our side of the deal:**

* We’ll be clear, we’ll move fast, and we’ll invest in your success. You deserve to be supported, challenged, and rewarded for the impact you make—and we commit to doing that every step of the way.
* The starting pay for this role is 3,000,000 INR with 10% MBO. Discover how you can grow, lead, and make an impact by visiting our career page to learn more. NAVEX is an equal opportunity employer committed to including individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities and veteran status.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description: About Teleradiology Solutions / DaignostixTeleradiology Solutions (TRS), founded in 2002 by two Yale-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, provides 24x7 diagnostic radiology reporting to over 150 hospitals across 21 countries, through a network of radiologists (US, Indian certified) and technology-driven workflows.Daignostix, the AI arm of TRS based in Whitefield, Bengaluru, builds clinical AI for medical imaging and healthcare workflows. TRS also maintains an active academic and research focus, including AI in radiology (www.radguru.net).Role Summary:Daignostix builds clinical AI for medical imaging, with algorithms spanning neuro and stroke, pulmonary embolism, aortic pathology, urology, spine and rib fracture, solid-organ trauma and paediatric chest. Our models run on real patient studies alongside radiologists (US, Indian certified), so success means clinical accuracy, robustness, latency and safe operation in production.As a Senior AI Engineer, you will own clinical AI algorithms end to end: problem formulation, data and ground truth, modelling, clinical evaluation, production deployment and monitoring. This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who has already shipped and operated production AI systems.Roles and Responsibilities:● End-to-end algorithm ownership. Own one or more clinical AI algorithms from proposal through data strategy, modelling, validation, deployment, monitoring and improvement. Define the technical plan, flag risks early and drive decisions to closure.● Model development. Design and train CNN, transformer and hybrid models for classification, detection and segmentation, using classical ML where it is the better fit.● Data and ground truth. Architect DICOM pipelines and dataset curation with lineage and versioning. Catch leakage, label-quality issues, cohort bias and scanner/site variability before they become model problems.● Clinical evaluation. Define evaluation protocols, clinical metrics, calibration and subgroup analyses. Lead false-positive/false-negative review and threshold selection with radiologists (US, Indian certified).● Production engineering. Turn validated models into production services (Docker, FastAPI/REST) with robust GPU inference, observability and safe failure behaviour. Optimise with ONNX, TensorRT or CUDA where it measurably helps without changing clinical outputs.● MLOps and reliability. Deploy on AWS, Azure or GCP and on on-premise GPU infrastructure. Own experiment tracking, model registries, CI/CD, regression and golden-set testing, drift monitoring and rollback.● Technical leadership. Lead design, code and model-readiness reviews, mentor junior engineers and set engineering standards. This role has no people-management responsibility.Requirements:Must-have:● Education. B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/MS/M.Sc. from an IIT, IISc, IIIT, BITS Pilani or a comparably selective institution, in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, AI, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative field, with a strong academic record.● Experience. 5-8 years of hands-on AI/ML engineering, including multiple years taking deep-learning systems into production. Medical-imaging or healthcare AI experience is strongly preferred.● Product pedigree. Substantive AI/ML engineering experience at a leading medical-imaging AI company or a top-tier AI product or research organisation, with clear ownership of production AI products.● Proof of production ownership. Able to walk through at least two AI/ML systems you personally drove from data through deployment, monitoring and iteration, with measurable outcomes.● Programming. Expert Python, deep PyTorch and/or TensorFlow/Keras, and working proficiency in NumPy, scikit-learn and OpenCV.● ML depth. Strong command of deep learning, computer vision, classical ML, statistics, calibration and experimental design.● Production engineering. Linux, Git, Docker, FastAPI/REST, pytest, CI/CD, logging and monitoring, model/data versioning, and hands-on AWS, Azure or GCP.Good-to-have:● Scale and performance. Kubernetes, distributed training/inference, ONNX/TensorRT, CUDA profiling and infrastructure-as-code.● Medical imaging tooling. DICOM/NIfTI, MONAI and nnU-Net.● Multimodal AI. VLMs, LLMs, RAG and PEFT, as an addition to, not a substitute for, core deep-learning depth.Key Skills:Python | PyTorch | TensorFlow / Keras | NumPy | scikit-learn | OpenCV | Classical ML | CNNs | Vision Transformers | Detection | Segmentation | DICOM / NIfTI | MONAI / nnU-Net | Clinical Metrics | Calibration | Docker | FastAPI | pytest | CI/CD | MLflow / Weights & Biases | AWS / Azure / GCP | Kubernetes | ONNX / TensorRTWhy Join Daignostix:● Clinical AI that matters. Algorithms evaluated on real patient studies, where robustness, latency and reliability have direct operational consequences.● Direct access to radiologists. Work with subspecialist radiologists (US, Indian certified) on annotation strategy, threshold decisions and clinical failure analysis.● Senior influence, hands-on scope. Shape architecture and technical standards across GPU infrastructure, cloud and on-premise deployment, while staying close to code and data.

title: Junior AI Engineer
description:
**About Teleradiology Solutions / Daignostix**

Teleradiology Solutions (TRS), founded in 2002 by two Yale-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, provides 24x7 diagnostic radiology reporting to over 150 hospitals across 21 countries, through a network of radiologists (US, Indian certified) and technology-driven workflows.

Daignostix, the AI arm of TRS based in Whitefield, Bengaluru, builds clinical AI for medical imaging and healthcare workflows. TRS also maintains an active academic and research focus, including AI in radiology (www.radguru.net).

**Role Summary:**

Daignostix builds clinical AI for CT, MR, X-ray and ultrasound, with algorithms spanning neuro and stroke, pulmonary embolism, aortic pathology, urology, spine and rib fracture, solid-organ trauma and paediatric chest. Our models are used alongside radiologists (US, Indian certified), so quality is judged by clinical performance and reliability, not benchmark scores.

As a Junior AI Engineer, you will own scoped model workstreams (data, training, evaluation and error analysis) under the guidance of senior AI engineers, and support the move of validated models into production. Medical-imaging experience is welcome but not required; serious hands-on deep-learning work is.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

● Model development. Train, fine-tune and evaluate CNN- and transformer-based models for classification, detection and segmentation, starting from strong baselines and running disciplined, reproducible experiments.

● Scoped ownership. Own a defined model workstream under senior review, from dataset preparation through training, validation, documentation and hand-off.

● Data pipelines. Build and maintain DICOM pipelines for ingestion, de-identification, series selection, pre-processing, augmentation, annotation handling and dataset versioning.

● Evaluation and error analysis. Report clinical metrics (sensitivity, specificity, PPV/NPV, ROC-AUC/PR-AUC, per-case and per-lesion), analyse false positives and negatives by subgroup, and explain why the model fails.

● Radiologist collaboration. Work with radiologists (US, Indian certified) to define labels, review difficult cases and turn clinical feedback into measurable model improvements.

● Production support. Contribute to packaging validated models as tested inference services (Python, Docker, FastAPI), including unit and regression tests that confirm changes do not alter clinical outputs. Senior engineers lead serving architecture, optimisation and deployment.

**Requirements:**

**Must-have:**

● Education. B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/MS/M.Sc. from an IIT, IISc, IIIT, BITS Pilani or a comparably selective institution, in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, AI, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative field, with a strong academic record.

● Experience. 2-4 years of hands-on AI/ML engineering or research experience, including deep-learning work beyond coursework, tutorials, notebooks or API wrappers.

● Proof of building. At least one substantial computer-vision system or research contribution that you personally drove into a reproducible pipeline, service or real downstream use, and can defend in technical depth.

● Programming. Strong Python and NumPy, and deep hands-on experience in PyTorch or TensorFlow/Keras. Able to debug data loaders, leakage, incorrect metrics and unstable training.

● Fundamentals. Solid grounding in deep learning and computer vision (CNNs, vision transformers, detection, segmentation, transfer learning) and in statistics and experimental design (ROC/PR analysis, thresholds, calibration).

● Engineering basics. Linux, Git, clean modular Python, Docker, pytest and basic CI/CD.

Good-to-have:

● Medical imaging. Experience with DICOM/NIfTI, MONAI or nnU-Net.

● Production exposure. Model serving with FastAPI, ONNX/TensorRT, and experiment tracking with MLflow or Weights & Biases.

● LLMs and cloud. Exposure to LLMs, embeddings or RAG, and to one of AWS, Azure or GCP. These add to, but do not replace, core deep-learning skills.

**Key Skills:**

Python | PyTorch | TensorFlow / Keras | NumPy | OpenCV | scikit-learn | CNNs | Vision Transformers | Detection | Segmentation | DICOM / NIfTI | Clinical Metrics | Error Analysis | Git | Linux | Docker | FastAPI | pytest | MLflow / Weights & Biases

**Why Join Daignostix:**

● Real clinical AI. Build models for real medical-imaging workflows and see how they affect radiologists and patients.

● Direct access to radiologists. Work closely with subspecialist radiologists (US, Indian certified) on ground truth, difficult cases and failure analysis.

● Mentorship with ownership. Senior technical review, dedicated on-premise GPU infrastructure, and visibility across development, deployment, clinical validation and regulatory pathways.

title: Sr. AI Engineer
description:
**Our Mission:**
6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.
  
  
**Our People:**
People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.
  
  
**Job Description**
6sense has agents and an MCP server in production today, used by real customers. This role takes them further by building more capable agents, strengthening the API and tool layer, and creating an ecosystem that external agents, clients, and partners can connect to.
  
  
You'll work across the full journey from a customer's agent to 6sense data and actions—including APIs, tools, MCP, orchestration, context, evaluation, and security.
  
  
6sense is working to become the default Contextual Intelligence layer for B2B. Agents and MCP are how that context reaches customers, partners, and their AI tools. You'll partner closely with the team building contextual intelligence, write production Python daily, own multi-month projects, support the teams and customers who depend on these systems, and keep the platform current as the agent tooling landscape evolves.
  
  
What You'll Own
  
  
Agents and Orchestration
  
  

* Extend LangGraph orchestrators with typed state, conditional routing, subgraphs, checkpointing, durable execution, and human-in-the-loop steps.
* Choose among routing, orchestrator-worker, plan-and-execute, reflection, and multi-agent handoff patterns based on the problem.
* Run agents headless—API- and MCP-first—across in-app, chat, workflow, and partner surfaces from one shared core.
* Maintain reusable components for state, memory, tool-calling, and agent-to-agent delegation with scoped permissions.

APIs, Tools, and MCP
  
  

* Evolve the APIs and tools agents use to read 6sense data and take action, for both human and LLM callers.
* Tune tool design for agent success, including names, descriptions, schemas, response shapes, error messages, and token-efficient outputs.
* Redesign and scale the MCP layer for production workloads, including concurrency, per-tenant quotas, latency budgets, caching, and graceful degradation, while maintaining backward compatibility and adopting new specification capabilities as they mature.
* Onboard external MCP clients, AI assistants, agent platforms, and partners. Write integration guides and reference clients, and define how 6sense consumes third-party MCP servers, including trust boundaries.
* Harden execution with idempotency, retries, rate limits, permissions, and spend controls. Maintain standards for tool contracts, versioning, and discovery.

Context and Evaluation
  
  

* Partner with the Contextual Intelligence team to expose context to agents through MCP, APIs, and tools, ensuring one context layer serves every surface. Establish contracts defining what each call returns, how fresh the information is, where it comes from, and how it is scoped to the tenant and user.
* Improve permission-aware retrieval and grounding through chunking, hybrid search, reranking, and citations. Optimize context assembly and memory within token and latency limits.
* Extend evaluation using golden datasets, tool-selection and tool-call accuracy, end-to-end task success, regression suites, and release gates, including context-quality measures.
* Expand tracing and usage analytics, and report on task success rate, tool-call precision, groundedness, latency, and cost per successful outcome.

Security, Privacy, and Trust
  
  

* Make security a first consideration in every tool, API, agent, and MCP change, and review your own and teammates' work for vulnerabilities.
* Enforce tenant isolation and user-level authorization on every call so agents never access data beyond the caller's permissions. Maintain short-lived, scoped credentials.
* Defend against prompt injection, tool poisoning, excessive agency, and data leakage through tool outputs, traces, and logs. Set runtime limits on steps, tokens, time, and cost.

Customers and Engineering Craft
  
  

* Triage and debug customer-reported issues across agents, tools, models, and downstream systems, identify root causes, and deliver fixes.
* Participate in customer and partner technical calls, and support enablement teams with guidance, demos, and documentation.
* Write design documents that clearly explain assumptions and trade-offs, review code and designs, mentor engineers earlier in their careers, and participate in on-call rotations and incident response.
* Track developments in MCP, agent frameworks, and model capabilities. Prototype promising technologies and provide short, evidence-backed recommendations.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 5+ years of experience building and running production software, with strong distributed-systems fundamentals, including idempotency, fault tolerance, backpressure, and failure recovery.
* 2+ years of experience building production LLM-based systems, including agents used by real customers.
* Strong Python skills and production experience with LangGraph or an equivalent orchestration framework.
* Experience designing APIs and tool interfaces for LLM callers, including schemas, descriptions, error handling, and tool-selection behavior. Direct MCP experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience scaling an API or platform used by external customers or partners, including authentication, rate limiting, versioning, and backward compatibility.
* Production experience with retrieval and grounding, as well as writing and running LLM evaluations.
* Experience with multi-tenant, security-sensitive cloud systems, preferably AWS, including authorization boundaries and data-leakage prevention.
* Experience debugging production issues across services and supporting customers directly or through support and solutions teams.
* A track record of owning multi-month, cross-team projects independently and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical audiences.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience building or operating MCP servers in production, or contributing to MCP open-source projects.
* Experience serving context to agents from signals, entity data, knowledge graphs, or enterprise data platforms.
* Experience integrating with external agent platforms or AI assistants as a partner, or working with agent interoperability protocols.
* Experience with B2B go-to-market, RevTech, CRM, or intent-data platforms.
* Experience with model routing, caching, and cost/latency optimization.
* Experience with Kafka, Snowflake, Databricks, or Spark.

What This Role Is Not
  
  

* Not an architect role: You'll set direction through working code and design documents.
* Not MCP-only: MCP sits alongside APIs, tools, and orchestration.
* Not a greenfield build: These systems are live, with real customers depending on them.

**Our Benefits:**
Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.
  
  
We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.

title: Sr AI Agent Engineer
description:
Lexsi Labs is a frontier AI lab focused on building 
****aligned, interpretable, and safe superintelligent systems****

. Our work spans alignment methodologies, interpretability-led system design, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and enterprise data. We build AI systems intended for real-world deployment, where transparency, auditability, and robustness are first-class constraints.

We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behavior.

****The Role****

We are building a 
****high-autonomy AI Engineering Agent****

 that can execute end-to-end AI engineering workflows on top of the Lexsi backend. The system is designed to reason over complex objectives, plan multi-step actions, interact with tools and data systems, evaluate outcomes, and iterate over long horizons while remaining interpretable and aligned.

As a 
****Sr AI Agent Engineer****

, you will be responsible for defining and building the core agent architecture. You will make foundational decisions about how the agent reasons, plans and executes actions, maintains memory and state, and has its decisions inspected and explained. This role requires deep hands-on engineering and the ability to operate in ambiguous environments with ownership from day one.

****What You’ll Build****

* ****End-to-end AI Engineering Agents****

   that can autonomously perform tasks such as experiment design, evaluation, analysis, and reporting, rather than merely assisting a human in these workflows.
* ****Harness Engineering:****

   Able to design and maintain complex harness components that support agents' scale exponentially for complex tasks.
* ****Agent architectures that combine reasoning, planning, tool orchestration, and memory****

  , with explicit handling of long-horizon execution, partial failures, and self-correction.
* ****Deep integrations with the Lexsi backend****

  , including internal evaluation systems, data pipelines, and alignment tooling, as well as enterprise APIs and proprietary data sources.
* ****Agents designed for enterprise and regulated environments****

  , where every action, decision, and output must be inspectable, explainable, and defensible.

****Responsibilities****

* ****Own the architecture and implementation of the AI Engineering Agent****

  , making early design decisions around planners, reasoning loops, memory models, and execution control that will shape the system long-term.
* ****Build robust tool orchestration and execution layers****

  , ensuring the agent can interact reliably with internal services, external APIs, and data systems, and recover gracefully from failures.
* ****Design and implement memory and state management****

  , enabling agents to operate across long-running tasks, retain relevant context, and reason over past actions and outcomes.
* ****Embed alignment, safety, and interpretability into the system design****

  , working closely with research teams to ensure that agent behavior is auditable and controllable by construction.
* ****Stress-test agent behavior in real-world conditions****

  , identifying edge cases, failure modes, and distribution shifts, and iterating on the system to improve reliability and correctness.
* ****Set a high engineering bar****

  , contributing to design discussions, code reviews, and technical decision-making with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

****Requirements****

* ****Significant experience building and shipping complex AI or ML-heavy systems****

  , where you have owned architecture and seen systems evolve in production, not just prototypes.
* ****Hands-on experience with agentic AI systems and frameworks****

  , such as ReAct-style agents, AutoGPT-like systems, LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or similar, with a clear understanding of their limitations and failure modes.
* ****Strong backend engineering fundamentals****

  , including advanced Python proficiency, experience building APIs and services, and familiarity with databases, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.
* ****A systems-thinking mindset****

  , with the ability to reason about performance, reliability, cost, safety, and interpretability as interconnected design constraints.
* ****Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments****

  , where problems are loosely specified and ownership is expected rather than assigned.

****Strong Bonus Signals****

* Experience building 
  ****long-horizon or stateful agent systems****

   that must reason over time rather than single-turn interactions.
* Prior exposure to 
  ****AI alignment, interpretability, or safety tooling****

  , especially in production or enterprise settings.
* Experience working in 
  ****regulated or high-stakes domains****

  , where system behavior must be explained and audited after deployment.
* A track record of debugging and improving systems that behaved unpredictably in the real world.

We move quickly and expect candidates to do the same. We value substance over polish and execution over rhetoric.

title: Applied AI ML Senior Associate
description:
**Job Description**
Join a world-class data science team at JPMorgan Chase and help shape the future of our Chief Administrative Office.
  
  
As a Data Scientist Senior Associate in the Chief Data & Analytics Office, you will lead the development and deployment of innovative AI and machine learning solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to address complex business challenges, drive adoption of modern ML practices, and ensure responsible AI governance. You will have the opportunity to work with state-of-the-art technologies and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.

* Lead the hands-on design, development, and deployment of advanced AI, GenAI, and large language model solutions.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on a wide range of machine learning techniques and optimizations.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to deliver scalable, production-ready AI systems.
* Conduct experiments using the latest ML technologies, analyze results, and tune models for optimal performance.
* Own end-to-end code development in Python for both proof-of-concept and production-ready solutions.

* Drive adoption of modern ML infrastructure, tools, and best practices.
* Optimize system accuracy and performance by identifying and resolving inefficiencies.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.

* Proven experience designing, training, and deploying large-scale ML/AI models in production environments.

* Familiarity with big data processing tools and cloud data services.

Morgan and Chase brands. title: Junior AI Engineer – Applied AI (Non-Clinical)
description:
**About Teleradiology Solutions / Daignostix**

Teleradiology Solutions (TRS), founded in 2002 by two Yale-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, provides 24x7 diagnostic radiology reporting to over 150 hospitals across 21 countries, through a network of radiologists (US, Indian certified) and technology-driven workflows.

Daignostix, the AI arm of TRS based in Whitefield, Bengaluru, builds clinical AI for medical imaging and healthcare workflows. TRS also maintains an active academic and research focus, including AI in radiology (www.radguru.net).

**Role Summary**

Daignostix builds the AI behind TRS's 24x7 teleradiology operations and the products used by radiologists, hospital partners and internal teams. Beyond clinical imaging models, this includes algorithms that route and prioritise cases, predict TAT and forecast volumes and radiologist coverage, along with mobile applications that put these capabilities in users' hands.

As a Junior AI Engineer – Applied AI (Non-Clinical), you will build and ship operational ML algorithms and AI-enabled mobile features end to end under the guidance of senior engineers, using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code to move quickly without compromising quality. This role does not work on clinical diagnostic models.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

●      
**Operational algorithms.**
Build, train and evaluate models for case routing and worklist prioritisation, TAT prediction, radiologist scheduling and RVU/volume forecasting, and anomaly detection on operational data.

●      
**Mobile AI features.**
Build AI-enabled features in mobile apps (React Native, Flutter or native iOS/Android) and integrate them with backend model services.

●      
**On-device inference.**
Convert, optimize, and deploy machine learning models such as LightGBM, XGBoost, and scikit-learn models for production use, balancing accuracy, inference latency, memory usage, and model size.

●      
**Data and evaluation.**
Build data pipelines from operational systems, define success metrics with operations stakeholders, and measure model impact against baselines in production.

●      
**AI-assisted development.**
Use Claude Code and similar agentic coding tools in day-to-day development, while owning the review, testing and correctness of everything you ship.

AI Engineer with deep, hands-on expertise in building production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications. title: Forward-Deployed AI Engineer
description:
Why Choose Bottomline?
  
  
Are you ready to transform the way businesses pay and get paid? Bottomline is a global leader in business payments and cash management, with over 35 years of experience and moving more than $16 trillion in payments annually. We're looking for passionate individuals to join our team and help drive impactful results for our customers. If you're dedicated to delighting customers and promoting growth and innovation - we want you on our team!
  
  
Job Description:
**Forward-Deployed AI Engineer**
**Location**
**India (Pune / Bangalore / Remote India)**
**Reports To**
Snr. Director of AI and Data, Enterprise Data Services (UK)
  
  
**Level**
Individual Contributor (3-4 years experience)
  
  
**Team**
Enterprise Data Services — AI Engineering
  
  
**Contract**
Permanent, Full-Time
  
  
**HRFs**
BTF27272, BTF27273
  
  
**About The Team**
Enterprise Data Services (EDS) is Bottomline's AI Engineering function. We don't build AI as a side tool — we build AI-native solutions where intelligence IS the product. Our platform runs on Snowflake, and we use Snowflake's native AI capabilities (Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst, ML Functions) to solve business problems directly in the data platform, no external ML infrastructure, no separate serving layer, no handoffs between teams.
  
  
We currently ship: churn prediction agents, contract intelligence, partner reporting automation, a governance control plane, and much more. Everything runs in Snowflake. Everything is versioned, tested, and production-governed.
  
  
**The Role**
We're looking for an Forward-Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) who can take a business problem and solve it natively in Snowflake — from feature engineering through model training to deployment as a live service. This is not a platform-building role. You won't be designing schemas or managing pipelines. You'll be the person who turns business questions into working AI solutions that run in production.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Take business problems (e.g. churn risk, propensity to buy, anomaly detection, document intelligence) and design AI solutions using Snowflake-native capabilities
* Build and evaluate ML models using Snowflake ML Functions, Snowpark ML, and Cortex AI
* Design and implement Cortex Agents that combine structured data queries with unstructured document intelligence
* Create evaluation frameworks (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, human review loops) to prove solutions meet success metrics
* Work with Cortex Analyst semantic views to enable natural language access to business data
* Build Cortex Search services over unstructured documents (contracts, support tickets, product docs etc.)
* Collaborate with AI and Data Engineers who handles platform infrastructure, you focus on the science, they handle the plumbing
* Present findings and recommendations to business stakeholders in plain language
* Contribute to the AI project lifecycle: framing problems, running spikes, evaluating results, and iterating

**Requirements**
**Must Have**

* 3-4 years experience in data science, machine learning, or applied AI
* Strong Python (pandas, scikit-learn, numpy), you think in DataFrames
* SQL fluency, comfortable writing complex analytical queries, window functions, CTEs
* Experience building classification or regression models and evaluating them rigorously (precision, recall, F1, AUC)
* Experience with at least one of: NLP, document extraction, recommendation systems, or anomaly detection
* Comfortable working with messy real-world data — missing values, inconsistent formats, multiple sources
* Great communications skills and can work directly with stakeholders end to end
* Can communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders clearly

**Strong Preference**

* Snowflake experience (Snowpark Python, Cortex AI functions, ML model registry)
* Experience with LLMs in production (prompt engineering, RAG architectures, evaluation of generative outputs)
* Understanding of Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, or Cortex Analyst
* Experience building evaluation sets and measuring AI quality systematically (not just accuracy, precision/recall tradeoffs, error analysis)
* Familiarity with feature engineering for tabular business data (customer signals, transaction patterns, contract attributes etc)

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in Fintech, B2B payments, or B2B SaaS
* Familiarity with A/B testing or causal inference methods
* Experience with Streamlit for rapid prototyping of data apps

**Our Tech Stack**

* Snowflake (everything lives here): Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst, Snowpark Python, ML Functions, Dynamic Tables
* Python: pandas, scikit-learn, snowpark-ml, evaluation frameworks
* Version control: Git, Snowflake stage-based deployment
* Visualisation: Streamlit in Snowflake, Cortex Code (IDE), PowerBI

**Why This Role Is Different**

* AI-native, not AI-assisted: You will build solutions where the AI IS the product, not a feature bolted onto something else
* No ML infrastructure tax: Everything runs natively in Snowflake — no Docker, no Kubernetes, no model serving endpoints to manage
* You will have business impact from day one: with a prioritised backlog of Quick Win candidates waiting for someone to build them
* Direct line to stakeholders: No layers of middle management between you and the business problem.
* Modern AI engineering practices: Lifecycle-governed (Framing > Spikes > Build > Evaluate > Governance > Adoption), evaluation-driven, with a real governance plane

**Your First 90 Days**
**Days 1-30: Learn**

* Understand the Snowflake platform and Cortex AI capabilities
* Run through the AI project lifecycle on a small candidate

**Days 30-60: Spike**

* Own your first AI candidate from the prioritised backlog
* Run a timeboxed spikes: build the crudest version that proves positive signal
* Create your first golden evaluation dataset
* Present spike findings to the team

**Days 60-90: Build**

* Build your spike to production standard with proper evaluation
* Pass through governance gates
* Ship your first AI solution to production

We welcome talent at all career stages and are dedicated to understanding and supporting additional needs. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an inclusive and open environment for everyone.

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer: LLM & Agent Stack
description:
**About TrueFoundry**
Every production AI system, whether it's powering customer support, writing code, analyzing financial data, or diagnosing medical conditions, needs the same foundational infrastructure.
  
  
A way to route between models. A way to manage tools and integrate them securely. A way to orchestrate agents and enforce governance. A unified compute layer to run it all.
  
  
**That infrastructure layer is being built right now.**
We are looking for a Senior AI/ML Engineer: LLM & Agent Stack to join the team.
  
  
**The Problem We're Solving**
Companies are moving beyond simple chatbots to production agentic systems. These systems route between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and self-hosted models. They integrate dozens of tools via protocols like MCP. They orchestrate multi-agent workflows where agents coordinate with other agents.
  
  
The infrastructure to support this doesn't exist yet. You can't just duct-tape together a few API calls and call it production-ready.
  
  
**You Need a Control Plane That Handles**

* Intelligent routing with observability, cost policies, and fallback logic
* Centralized tool and MCP server management with security and lifecycle controls
* Agent orchestration with governance and guardrails
* A unified compute layer to run self-hosted models, custom tools, and agents

**AI Gateway**
is the control plane, a five-composable components (Prompts, LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway, Guardrails, Agent Gateway) that handle routing, orchestration, and governance.
  
  
We're Series A, backed by Intel Capital and Sequoia. Companies like CVS, Mastercard, Siemens, Paytm, Synopsys, and Zscaler run production AI workloads on our platform.
  
  
**Role Summary**
You’ll design and own core components that enable enterprise customers to run production agentic AI safely and efficiently on TrueFoundry. This includes building robust orchestration for multi-step agents (graph/stateful workflows), model/routing logic, observability and policy enforcement (cost, data residency, rate limiting), and integrating upstream tooling like LangGraph, LangChain, vector stores, and specialized LLM runtimes.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Architect and implement scalable agent orchestration patterns (graph-based executors, state management, multi-agent coordination) for production workloads.
* Own critical integrations: model adapters, LLM gateway hooks, vector DBs, tools & external APIs, and the platform’s LLMops flows.
* Build and improve tracing, benchmarking and observability for LLMs and agents, token/cost accounting, latency p95, throughput, and correctness checks.
* Drive design for safety/guardrails: moderation hooks, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, replayable audit trails and policy enforcement.
* Mentor junior engineers, run design reviews, and improve engineering practices (testing, CI/CD, chaos testing for agents).
* Work directly with strategic customers to prototype complex agentic solutions and translate them into product features.

**Must-have**

* 4–10 years of software engineering with substantial experience building distributed systems, infra, or ML platforms.
* Deep practical experience integrating and deploying LLMs in production (RAG, retrieval, embeddings pipelines).
* Hands-on experience with agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph / LangChain or custom agent runtimes) and stateful workflow design.
* Proven track record building observability, cost controls, and policy enforcement for production services.

**Preferred / Differentiators**

* Experience building or contributing to open-source LLM orchestration tools (LangGraph, LangChain, or similar).
* Familiarity with enterprise constraints: on-prem/cloud hybrid deployments, data residency, compliance requirements.
* Background in security, privacy, or model governance for LLMs.
* Demonstrated leadership in cross-functional projects and direct customer engagement.

**Qualifications & Signals We Like**

* Open-source contributions, architecture blogs, or public talks on agentic LLMs or LLMops.
* Examples of productizing research or shipping complex infra features.

**Traits we are looking for:**
Ownership, ability to execute, hustle and think out of the box, data-driven decision making, be comfortable with more unknowns than knowns.
  
  
**Perks of Working at TrueFoundry**

* Join a fast-growing Series A, Bay Area-based startup building cutting-edge AI infrastructure.
* Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family.
* Flexible hybrid work, 3 days a week in the office (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday), with flexibility around the schedule.
* Lunch and snacks are on us whenever you come into the office.
* Work from another TrueFoundry office for up to 3 months each year, whether that's our London or Bay Area office, if you'd like a change of scenery.

title: Senior Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) Engineer
description:
**Summary**
We are looking for a
**Senior Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) Engineer**
to join our ASR Research & Development team. In this role, you will work on challenging research problems and develop state-of-the-art speech recognition technologies that improve real-world user experiences across multiple languages. You will combine research, experimentation, and hands-on model development to improve ASR accuracy, optimise training pipelines, and enhance language modelling capabilities. You will evaluate emerging algorithms, analyse large-scale speech and product usage data, and contribute to the continuous improvement of model architectures and training recipes. Experience training and optimising
**Conformer-based ASR models**
will be highly desirable.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Research, develop, train, and optimise end-to-end ASR models to improve speech recognition accuracy and robustness.
* Conduct experiments to evaluate ASR model quality and analyse the impact of hyperparameters, training strategies, and model configurations.
* Develop and improve model training recipes, fine-tuning strategies, and language modelling techniques.
* Work with Conformer-based architectures and other state-of-the-art speech recognition models, including model training and optimisation where applicable.
* Identify, curate, clean, optimise, and cluster speech and text training datasets to improve model performance.
* Analyse large-scale product usage data and speech recognition errors to identify performance gaps and opportunities for improvement.
* Apply model optimisation techniques, including pruning, efficient representations, model compression, and language model interpolation.
* Improve ASR performance across multiple languages, accents, speaking styles, and real-world acoustic conditions.
* Stay up to date with advancements in speech technology, deep learning, computational linguistics, and natural language processing.
* Design and execute research experiments, interpret results, and present findings and recommendations to the research team.
* Collaborate with cross-functional engineering, research, and product teams to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Maintain high standards of code quality, reproducibility, experimentation, and documentation.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Computational Linguistics, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in speech technology, ASR, machine learning, or a closely related research and development field.
* Strong background in speech recognition, computational linguistics, machine translation, and/or natural language processing.
* Extensive hands-on experience with end-to-end ASR systems and language modelling.
* Strong understanding of deep learning architectures, machine learning principles, statistical methods, and model evaluation techniques.
* Practical experience with model training, fine-tuning, hyperparameter optimisation, and performance evaluation.
* Proficiency in Python and shell scripting, with strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Experience working in Linux environments; familiarity with Windows-based development environments.
* Ability to analyse experimental results, investigate model errors, and identify effective solutions to complex technical problems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience training, fine-tuning, and optimising Conformer-based ASR models.
* Experience with Transformer-based architectures, attention mechanisms, sequence modelling, and modern end-to-end speech recognition approaches.
* Knowledge of acoustic modelling, pronunciation modelling, decoding strategies, and speech recognition evaluation metrics such as Word Error Rate (WER) and Character Error Rate (CER).
* Experience with large-scale speech data processing, dataset selection, data augmentation, and multilingual speech modelling.
* Experience with generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and fine-tuning techniques.
* Expertise in one or more areas such as machine learning, statistical modelling, information retrieval, deep learning, or data mining.
* Experience with model compression, pruning, quantisation, efficient inference, or deployment optimisation.
* Familiarity with ASR frameworks and tools such as ESPnet, NVIDIA NeMo, SpeechBrain, Kaldi, or equivalent technologies.
* Fluency in a second language other than English.

title: Applied Scientist II, Amazon Search

We are embarking on a multi-year journey to improve the shopping experience for customers globally. Amazon Search team creates customer-focused search solutions and technologies that make shopping delightful and effortless for our customers. Our goal is to understand what customers are looking for in whatever language happens to be their choice at the moment and help them find what they need in Amazon's vast catalog of billions of products — starting from the very first keystroke.
  
  
As Amazon expands to new interfaces, we are faced with the unique challenge of maintaining the bar on Search Results Quality and Search Autocomplete.
  
  
We are looking for a Applied Scientist II to work on improving search on Amazon using NLP, ML, and DL technology. As an Applied Scientist, you will lead our efforts in query understanding, semantic matching, and ranking. You will build systems that anticipate search query intent and surface the right results. As part of this role, you will develop high precision, high recall, and low latency solutions for search. Your solutions should work for all languages that Amazon supports and will be used in all Amazon locales world-wide. * Develop and deploy ML models to produce relevant search results.

* Develop reinforcement learning and reward-modeling approaches to continuously improve search results quality.
* Train multi-objective ranking and scoring systems that balance suggestion diversity, specificity, and relevance.
* Design and implement scalable model architectures optimized for strict latency constraints, including knowledge distillation, quantization, and efficient inference strategies for production deployment.

**What you’ll bring:**

**Experience:**
1–3 years of relevant experience in AI/ML engineering, Azure application development, or a closely related role.

**Must-have capabilities:**

* Strong proficiency in Python for AI/ML development, scripting, API development and automation, plus development experience with .NET and C# in the Azure ecosystem.
* Solid command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, analysis and pipeline support.
* Hands-on experience building applications with large language models, including prompt engineering, RAG architectures, embeddings and fine-tuning.
* Experience with at least one agent-building framework such as Google ADK, LangChain or LangGraph, including tool use, memory management and multi-step agent orchestration.
* Working experience with Azure deployment, compute, storage and cloud-native AI/ML services.
* Practical knowledge of building and training models using TensorFlow, PyTorch or Scikit-learn.

**Preferred capabilities:**

* Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, Qdrant or FAISS for similarity search and RAG pipelines.
* Familiarity with MLOps and CI/CD tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow or Weights & Biases for experiment tracking, model versioning and deployment automation.
* Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes for packaging and orchestrating AI workloads.
* Experience building and exposing AI services through REST or gRPC APIs using FastAPI, Flask or similar frameworks.
* Familiarity with Apache Airflow, Prefect or equivalent workflow orchestration tools.
* Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Strong analytical thinking, clear communication, the ability to work independently and across teams, and a proactive problem-solving mindset.

Pentland Brands is the name behind some of the world’s best-known sport, outdoor and lifestyle brands, including Speedo, Berghaus, Canterbury, Endura, Ellesse, Kickers and Mitre.

We are a global family business with a clear purpose: pioneering brands that make life better. Across our teams, functions and locations, we work together to create products, experiences and partnerships that help people live more active, confident and positive lives.

Joining Pentland Brands means becoming part of a business where your work can have real reach, across multiple brands, markets, teams and disciplines. It is a place for people who want to contribute, collaborate, improve how things are done and help build the future of brands with heritage, ambition and global impact.

**Perks & Benefits**

Alongside a competitive salary and discretionary bonus, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, flexibility, and life outside work. This includes generous holiday allowance, hybrid and flexible working, employee transportation, pension and gratuity contributions, wellbeing support, medical, personal accident & term life insurance cover.

You can find full details of our benefits and perks on our UK Benefits page.

**The Interview Process**

We want our interview process to feel clear, straightforward, and supportive. If your experience and expectations look like a strong match for the role, here’s what you can expect next:

1. **Talent Team Intro Call**

2. **Experience Interview**

3. **Final Interview**

description:

Magnit is the future of work. Serving hundreds of the world’s most recognizable brands for the past 30+ years, Magnit offers the industry’s first holistic platform for the modern workforce. Magnit's integrated workforce management (IWM) platform supported by data, software, intelligence, and best-in-class services team is key to our clients’ success. At Magnit, you’ll work with passionate colleagues who collaborate and deliver meaningful results that positively transform the largest companies around the globe.
  
  
**Principal AI Engineer**
**About The Role**
We’re hiring a
**Principal AI Engineer**
to lead how we design, build, and productize generative and agentic AI, both inside our SaaS platform and across our products. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you’ll own the architecture for production AI agents, set the standards teams follow to take AI from prototype to production, and mentor engineers along the way.
  
  
The hard problems here aren’t model demos. They’re reliable, safe, observable agent systems running in production: orchestration, memory, guardrails, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop control. You’ll be the person we trust to define what good looks like for AI engineering, and to make sure we build it responsibly.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the architecture for generative and agentic AI across our SaaS platform, and stay hands-on in the most complex, critical components.
* Design and ship multi-agent systems that reason, plan, and execute, including the agentic loops, control flow, and failure isolation that keep them reliable in production.
* Build agent harnesses, reusable agent skills/tools, and MCP servers as the standard tool and integration layer between models and our systems, APIs, and data.
* Architect RAG systems (including GraphRAG) that ground outputs in trusted data, and event-driven pipelines that trigger and coordinate agents at scale.
* Productize agents end-to-end with guardrails, confidence-score-based routing, human-in-the-loop state machines, evaluation harnesses, tracing, and circuit breakers.
* Embed responsible-AI practices (privacy, bias mitigation, and auditability) directly into the reasoning and execution loops.
* Set architecture and code-quality standards, run design and code reviews, and mentor engineers; steer teams toward the right technologies and away from hype-driven choices.
* Make pragmatic build/buy decisions across frameworks, model providers, and orchestration patterns, balancing reliability, latency, security, and cost.
* Build with AI coding tools and AI-assisted development to raise team velocity and quality, with disciplined review gates.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years in software engineering, with a strong track record shipping production SaaS and large-scale, cloud-native distributed systems (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* 5+ years in technical leadership (Staff / Principal / Lead / Architect) driving cross-team decisions and mentoring engineers.
* Hands-on experience building GenAI applications: LLMs, prompt and context engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and RAG.
* Proven experience designing and shipping agentic AI systems: multi-agent orchestration, tool/function calling, agentic loops, memory, and autonomous execution, both embedded in a product and standalone.
* Depth in AI productization: guardrails, confidence-based logic, human-in-the-loop control, evaluation, observability, and reliability of agents in production.
* Experience building MCP servers (or equivalent tool layers), reusable agent skills, and event-driven architectures.
* Strong Python plus one of Go, Java, or TypeScript; fluency with modern AI and agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen).
* Practical experience building products with AI coding tools.
* Working knowledge of responsible AI: privacy, bias, and auditability.

* Building, fine-tuning, and deploying Small Language Models (SLMs) for routing, extraction, classification, and tool-calling, including on-device/edge and privacy-sensitive deployments.
* MLOps / LLMOps experience and observability/tracing stacks (e.g., OpenTelemetry).

title: Principal AI Engineer
description:
TechGrove is the
**Centre of Excellence**
for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

**Principal AI Engineer**

*TechGrove AI Engineering Pod*

You build the intelligent features that make software feel like magic, and you make them work in production. You are equally at home shipping a clean API, standing up a RAG pipeline, evaluating an agent, or tuning guardrails so an LLM behaves safely at scale. You are excited by the current moment in AI and pragmatic about where it actually adds value.

As Principal AI Engineer, you design and build the AI capabilities that differentiate an OpCo’s modernized applications: GenAI features, agentic workflows, and ML-powered functionality, integrated safely and reliably. You work side by side with the Technical Lead / Architect, contribute as a strong full-stack engineer, and help the whole pod raise its game in AI-native development.

If you want to turn the frontier of applied AI into shipped, dependable product features, this role is for you.

**About the Pod**

A TechGrove AI Engineering Pod is a self-contained, AI-native software delivery team that we embed inside one of our Operating Companies (OpCos) to build, modernize, and ship production software. Each pod pairs senior engineering talent with agentic AI tooling such as Claude Code, plus the accelerators of Banyan’s AI Application Modernization Factory, to deliver at a velocity and quality bar a traditional team cannot match.

A pod is typically four to eight people, and OpCos add more pods as their ambitions grow. You will work as part of a tight, high-trust team with real ownership of what you build. Pods are delivered from Banyan’s India-based TechGrove.

**What You Will Do**

* **Ship production AI/ML features:**
  Design, build, and deploy GenAI integrations, agentic workflows, RAG and GraphRAG systems, and ML-powered functionality into the OpCo’s modernized applications.
* **Orchestrate and integrate LLMs:**
  Implement LLM orchestration, prompt and context engineering, guardrails, and evaluation to deliver reliable, safe, production-grade AI.
* **Engineer cloud-native services:**
  Build scalable, secure, resilient services that host and serve AI capabilities, as a strong hands-on contributor.
* **Build agents and tooling:**
  Develop AI agents and tooling, including building and connecting MCP servers and tools, and champion agentic development practices across the pod’s SDLC.
* **Own data and retrieval:**
  Design the data, retrieval, and vector or knowledge-graph infrastructure that powers GenAI features, with quality, performance, and security built in.
* **Own technical design and quality:**
  Lead design and implementation for AI features, write clean, well-tested code, and uphold engineering standards, security, and observability.
* **Collaborate and mentor:**
  Partner with the Architect and senior engineers, and coach the team on AI/ML engineering best practices.
* **Apply pragmatic judgment:**
  Know where AI adds real value versus risk, and navigate a fast-moving landscape with a clear head.

**What You Bring**

* **Experience:**
  8+ years in software engineering, with significant hands-on experience implementing ML/AI features in production.
* **Production experience on AWS or Azure (required):**
  You have designed and built cloud-native applications on AWS or Azure, including containers, serverless, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform). Experience limited to GCP alone does not meet this requirement, although GCP in addition to AWS or Azure is a plus.
* **Applied AI/ML:**
  Demonstrated experience implementing GenAI capabilities (RAG and GraphRAG, LLM orchestration, prompt and context engineering, guardrail design) and/or ML features in production systems.
* **Agentic and GenAI frameworks:**
  Hands-on experience with GenAI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), multi-agent frameworks (crewAI, AutoGen, or similar), and developing AI agents and MCP servers and tools.
* **Software engineering depth:**
  Strong full-stack ability with solid SQL/No-SQL and API design skills.
* **Modern tech stacks:**
  Hands-on production experience with at least two of: .NET Core, Python, TypeScript, and Java.
* **AI-native tooling:**
  Fluency with AI-assisted development tooling (Claude Code or similar) as a daily, core part of your workflow.
* **Engineering principles:**
  Solid grounding in DDD, design patterns, clean code, test-driven development, and application security.
* **DevSecOps:**
  Experience with CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and cloud-native observability.
* **Collaboration:**
  Strong communication and an ownership mindset, comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change.
* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to Have**

* Deep LLM and vector database expertise: hybrid vector databases, knowledge graphs, and advanced prompt and guardrail design for enterprise AI safety.
* Experience fine-tuning or evaluating models, building eval harnesses, or implementing LLM observability.
* Experience building and operating multi-tenant SaaS at scale.
* Prior experience modernizing or re-platforming enterprise or B2B applications.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First 90 days:**
  You have shipped your first production AI feature, established reliable patterns for orchestration, retrieval, and evaluation, and the pod has a clear, safe approach to building with LLMs.
* **First 6 months:**
  AI capabilities are a dependable, differentiating part of the product, with measured quality and guardrails, and the team is meaningfully more capable in applied AI because of your mentorship.

**Why TechGrove, Why Banyan**

* **Permanent home, long-term thinking:**
  Banyan acquires great software businesses and keeps them for good. We invest for the long term, which means you build software meant to last, not to flip.
* **Real ownership:**
  You own outcomes end to end inside a small, senior team. The OpCo owns the “what”; the pod owns the “how.”
* **AI-native by default:**
  You work every day with agentic tooling and the AI Application Modernization Factory, not as a side experiment but as the core of how we build.
* **Variety with stability:**
  Pods work across a portfolio of real products and domains, so you keep learning, with the security of a permanent employer behind you.
* **Growth and excellence:**
  A Banyan Director of Engineering Excellence supports every pod with coaching, standards, and continuous improvement, so your craft compounds over time.

**Should You Apply?**

We have written this role to be honest about what it takes, not to describe a mythical perfect candidate. If you meet most of what is listed and you are excited by the work, we want to hear from you. Strong engineers grow into the rest, and we will help you do exactly that.

We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and we welcome applicants of every background. What matters most is the quality of your engineering, your curiosity about AI-native development, and your appetite to own outcomes.

***Beware of Recruitment Scams***

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.

**Protect yourself by following these steps:**

* Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an
  **@banyansoftware.com**
  email address.
* Remember, employers will
  **never**
  request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
* If you receive a suspicious message,
  **do not respond**
  — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

**AI-first and agentic development practices**
.

* Develop and enhance the organization's multi-agent AI application, including agents, tools, workflows, integrations, and automations.
* Work with multiple LLMs and public AI models and evaluate their suitability for different use cases.
* Implement agent orchestration, tool use, prompting, context management, grounding, and workflow execution.
* Build reusable AI capabilities that can be leveraged across Salesforce projects.
* Prototype new AI capabilities and convert successful PoCs into production-ready solutions.
* Continuously experiment with emerging AI frameworks, models, and developer tools.

Agentic Salesforce Delivery
  
  

* Work as a Senior Resource on delivery projects, using AI and agentic development approaches to accelerate and improve delivery.
* Use the AI platform and associated agents, tools, and workflows across the Salesforce development lifecycle.
* Apply agentic approaches to activities including analysis, design, coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and deployment.
* Build and review Salesforce solutions using Apex, LWC, Flow, integrations, APIs, and other Salesforce technologies.
* Ensure AI-assisted and AI-generated solutions meet Salesforce architecture, security, quality, and engineering standards.
* Identify opportunities within projects to automate repetitive development activities and improve developer productivity.

Platform Support & Problem Solving
  
  

* Support Salesforce projects using the AI delivery platform and resolve incoming technical issues.
* Diagnose problems across the application, agents, LLMs, prompts, tools, integrations, and Salesforce components.
* Work with Technical Architects and the AI application owner to identify root causes and implement sustainable fixes.
* Identify recurring project issues and convert solutions into reusable platform capabilities.
* Feed project experience and user feedback into continuous improvement of the AI platform.

Enablement & Technical Leadership
  
  

* Guide Salesforce developers and project teams in agentic ways of working and AI-assisted development.
* Help teams understand how and when to use agents, AI tools, and platform capabilities effectively.
* Establish and share practical patterns, best practices, and lessons learned from real project delivery.
* Collaborate with Technical Architects and the AI application owner to drive adoption and improve delivery outcomes.

Builder & Engineering Mindset
  
  

* Be a hands-on developer who builds and ships working solutions, rather than primarily a design/documentation role.
* Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, and similar tools.
* Follow modern engineering practices including Git, CI/CD, testing, code reviews, and maintainable design.
* Balance rapid experimentation with scalability, security, reliability, and production quality.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5–7 years of Salesforce/software engineering experience with strong hands-on Salesforce development skills.
* Strong experience with Apex, LWC, SOQL, Flow, APIs, integrations, and Salesforce metadata.
* Experience building multi-agent or agentic AI applications.
* Experience working with multiple LLM providers/models.
* Experience with MCP, agent orchestration, RAG, vector search, or LLM evaluation.
* Hands-on experience with Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, or similar AI coding tools.
* Experience integrating AI applications with Salesforce APIs, metadata, repositories, or development environments.
* Experience with Agentforce or other enterprise AI/agent platforms.
* Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer II, Application Architect, or System Architect.

Key Attributes
  
  

* Builder: Comfortable building and shipping both Salesforce and AI solutions.
* AI Practitioner: Uses AI and agentic approaches as part of day-to-day development.
* Salesforce Technologist: Strong understanding of enterprise Salesforce development and architecture.
* Problem Solver: Can debug issues across AI, application, integration, and Salesforce layers.
* Enabler: Helps other developers and teams adopt agentic ways of working.
* Product Mindset: Turns project learnings into reusable platform capabilities.
* Collaborator: Works closely with architects, the AI platform owner, and delivery teams.

Success in the Role
  
  
Success means
**improving the AI delivery platform while delivering Salesforce projects more effectively through agentic development**
.
  
  
The Senior Technical Consultant will act as a key
**bridge between AI platform engineering and Salesforce delivery**
— building the platform, using it to deliver real projects, solving adoption and technical challenges, and enabling other developers to adopt agentic ways of working.
