title: Senior Forward Deployed Architect, Generative AI
description:
**Job Description**
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It's a unique legacy of innovation that's fueled by great technology and amazing people. Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Join our team and discover how you can build a lasting impact on the world.
  
  
NVIDIA is looking for a Forward Deployed Architect to provide technical leadership and strategic guidance across AI Accelerator engagements with AI Native organizations, NeoCloud Providers, and ISVs. You'll advise on architecture and integration, define what good looks like, and bring learnings back to inform the DSX product roadmap. This role is engaged when standard product capabilities are not enough and the work needs to be specialized. Curious about novel hardware before it has a playbook? Excited to define how new platforms get used at scale? Our team works alongside customers and partners on infrastructure problems no one has solved yet, helping teams adopt NVIDIA technology the right way and shaping how new AI workloads get deployed.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Cross-Account Technical Leadership. Provide architectural direction across strategic engagements where standard capabilities are not enough and advanced implementation, optimization, or integration customization is needed.
* Outcome-Focused Implementation. Help customers integrate the right components to deliver on their outcomes. Where DSX software fits, advise on adopting it the right way. Where it doesn't, help them succeed with the right alternative and bring the gap back to product and engineering.
* Hands-On Technical Leadership. Dive into complex technical challenges hands-on when needed to solve critical problems, validate architectures, or prove out solutions.
* Strategic Initiative Ownership. Lead technically demanding programs end to end, including third-party performance benchmarking across hardware and workloads.
* Pattern Identification and Knowledge Sharing. Identify common challenges and solution patterns across engagements. Share findings with internal teams and the broader AI community.
* Technical Standardization. Develop standardized approaches, reference architectures, and structured guidance rooted in patterns from successful engagements.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration. Partner with product, engineering, and other customer-facing NVIDIA teams so what we learn in the field informs internal strategy and capabilities.
* Strategic Architecture. Design technical strategies for advanced AI workloads (distributed training, large-scale inference, model and pipeline optimization, MLOps) that apply across multiple customers and partners.
* New Hardware Enablement. Help develop new infrastructure patterns and playbooks for the latest NVIDIA hardware as it lands with customers and partners.

What we need to see
  
  

* Bachelors degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years in technical roles such as solutions architecture, ML engineering, technical product management, or technical consulting across multiple customers or projects. Alternatively, 5+ years of specialist-level experience working at the frontier of AI infrastructure.
* Strong technical leadership with the ability to guide teams and influence technical decisions without direct authority.
* Systems thinking with the ability to understand customer outcomes and translate them into clear technical requirements and architectures.
* Willingness to prototype, implement, validate, and troubleshoot hands-on when needed to solve critical problems or prove out approaches.
* A solid technical foundation in the technologies AI infrastructure is built on, especially Linux systems administration.
* A self-directed learner who can ramp on brand new technologies and unfamiliar technical domains independently.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical teams, executives, and multi-functional collaborators.

Ways to stand out from the crowd
  
  

* Solutions architecture or technical consulting background across multiple customer engagements simultaneously, with experience bringing novel AI hardware or frameworks to production with frontier AI Native organizations, hyperscalers, NeoClouds, or ISVs.
* A foundational cloud or distributed systems background built at hyperscaler scale.
* A public technical voice: blog posts, talks, open-source contributions, or reference work that shows depth and opinion.
* Hands-On Technical Expertise in one or more of: NVIDIA Stack (CUDA, NeMo, Triton, TensorRT, NIM, DGX Cloud, and the broader DSX software portfolio), Inference Systems (large-scale inference with frameworks like vLLM and SGLang, prefill-decode disaggregation, performance optimization across hardware), Training Systems (distributed training, model and pipeline optimization, open-source generative AI frameworks), Infrastructure (SLURM, Kubernetes, GPU scheduling, distributed computing frameworks, rack-scale systems, multiple CSP or NCP cloud environments), and Observability and Automation (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, GPU performance monitoring).

title: Forward-Deployed AI Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
About Turing
  
  
Turing’s mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end-to-end agentic AI systems inside mission-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at www.turing.com.
  
  
Role: Forward-Deployed AI Engineer — Enterprise AI
  
  
Location: Bengaluru, India
  
  
Experience Level: 8+ years
  
  
Work Model: Hybrid, 3 days per week in office
  
  
Why Join Enterprise AI?
  
  
Enterprise AI is a distinct business unit within Turing, operating with the speed, focus, and ownership of a rapidly scaling startup. When it comes to applied AI in the workplace, you’ll define the frontier by building beyond it.
  
  
You’ll join the initial team of Forward-Deployed Engineers, shaping how we work while solving enterprise-grade problems for the world’s leading enterprises. As a Forward-Deployed AI Engineer, you’ll own outcomes end to end—from identifying high-value customer problems and shaping architecture to building production systems and working directly with senior client leaders.
  
  
You’ll develop generative AI solutions in the real world, driving measurable impact and return on investment within large institutions. Enterprise AI is intense, intellectually challenging work. It won’t be for everyone, but it may be exactly the challenge you’re looking for.
  
  
As a Forward-Deployed Engineer, You Will
  
  
Find the Problem Worth Solving
  
  
Work directly with customers to navigate ambiguity, uncover high-value opportunities, challenge assumptions, and translate complex business needs into clear technical direction. This requires curiosity and business acumen as you discover business workflows and jointly define the outcomes an AI solution should drive.
  
  
Build Beyond the Frontier
  
  
Architect and build production AI systems, from multi-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, context engineering, memory and state, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to the APIs, data pipelines, integrations, and distributed systems that make them reliable at scale.
  
  
Own the Outcome
  
  
You won’t simply be given a list of responsibilities—you’ll have the authority to own the outcome for your client and make a real-world impact through your work. You’ll lead solutions from discovery through deployment and measurable impact while staying hands-on and owning evaluation, observability, security, reliability, latency, scalability, and cost.
  
  
The Anti-Sell
  
  
High ownership and intensity: This role requires exceptional ownership and accountability. You’ll work with clients who have uncompromising expectations for quality, making this a demanding environment—and an ideal proving ground for people who seek difficult, high-impact challenges.
  
  
Client-first and hybrid: This role is based in Bengaluru or Hyderabad and requires working from the office three days per week. Candidates must currently be based in one of these two cities. Relocation assistance is not available.
  
  
You’ll help write the playbook: Enterprise AI operates like a startup. You may not always have an established process or playbook because you’ll be expected to apply your expertise, judgment, and technical depth to create one.
  
  
Our Forward-Deployed Engineers Typically Have
  
  
Deep production engineering experience: Typically 8+ years building and operating sophisticated software systems, with expertise in Python, backend systems, APIs, databases, distributed systems, system design, and cloud infrastructure.
  
  
Hands-on agentic AI experience: Experience building production LLM and agent systems using orchestration, tool use, context engineering, memory and state, retrieval, and multistep workflows.
  
  
Strong retrieval depth: Experience building and improving production retrieval systems, with a practical understanding of embeddings, vector and hybrid search, reranking, evaluation, and diagnosing retrieval quality.
  
  
End-to-end systems ownership: A track record of taking complex systems from architecture through deployment and scale, with a practical understanding of evaluation, observability, reliability, security, guardrails, latency, scalability, and cost.
  
  
Exceptional customer and technical leadership: The ability to enter unfamiliar environments, earn trust quickly, navigate ambiguity, challenge assumptions constructively, and communicate effectively with senior engineers and business executives.
  
  
Client-ready communication: The ability to explain technical concepts clearly, navigate ambiguity, work with stakeholders, and remain calm under pressure.
  
  
Values
  
  

* We are client first: We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
* We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
* We are AI forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing
  
  

* Work at the frontier of AI, helping the world’s leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first-of-a-kind benchmarks.
* Contribute to leading-edge AI research and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS.
* Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise, applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real-world business challenges.
* Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies.
* Move at the pace of AI innovation, with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup.

Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
  
  
For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Applied AI Engineer to join Rubrik's Applied AI team, building production-grade, full-stack applications and APIs for our internal Business teams while embedding AI-agentified capabilities into these internal platforms. This is a hands-on build role: you will own features end to end — from database schema through backend services and distributed systems to the user interface — and bring practical, hands-on experience building or integrating AI agents, tool-calling workflows, or LLM-powered features into production systems that our business stakeholders rely on.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong full-stack engineering fundamentals with a systems mindset for reliability and scale, and has spent meaningful hands-on time (1–2 years) building AI-agentified applications — not just experimenting with AI tools, but shipping agentic features in production. We are targeting 8+ years of overall software engineering experience; this is flexible for candidates who demonstrate strong depth across full-stack, distributed systems, and applied AI during technical evaluation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own features end to end — database schema, backend services, APIs, and frontend (React/Next.js) user interface — operating as an owner rather than a ticket-taker.
* Build full-stack web applications: responsive, production-grade frontends using React/Next.js, backed by well-designed REST APIs and backend services.
* Design and build APIs and services that are consumed by applications, internal tools, and AI agents/LLMs, including tool-calling interfaces..
* Build and productionize AI-agentified features — agentic workflows, LLM-powered automation, and AI-assisted tooling — grounded in 1–2 years of hands-on experience with these systems.
* Architect for distributed systems concerns: scalability, fault tolerance, data consistency, and service boundaries across backend and data layers.
* Apply reliability engineering practices — observability (logging, metrics, tracing), SLAs/SLOs, incident response, and post-incident reviews — to keep production systems healthy.
* Design and optimize relational database schemas, including joins, indexing, and query performance tuning.
* Build clean, well-tested, production-grade frontend and backend code that others can read, test, and extend.
* Clarify requirements upfront, surface blockers early, and communicate progress proactively without being asked.
* Collaborate openly with internal Business stakeholders, Product, QA, DevOps, and UX or designer teams; avoid working in silos.

**Required Qualifications**
***Education & Experience***

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience across full-stack development (flexible based on demonstrated strength in technical evaluation).
* 1–2 years of hands-on experience building, integrating, or operating AI-agentified applications (agentic workflows, tool-calling, RAG, or LLM-powered features) in production..
* Demonstrated experience owning systems designed for scale and reliability, not just feature delivery.

**Technical Skills — Applied AI**

* 1–2 years of hands-on experience building AI-agentified applications, including agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, ADK, or equivalent), tool/function-calling for LLMs.
* Practical understanding of AI-specific considerations: latency, cost, rate limiting, and safety/guardrails when exposing systems for AI consumption.
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code or similar).

**Technical Skills — Full Stack**

* Frontend: Strong JavaScript fundamentals; hands-on experience with React and Next.js for building modern, production-grade web applications (hooks, state management, component architecture, routing/SSR).
* Backend: Proficient in Python, writing production-grade code; hands-on experience with FastAPI or Flask (or equivalent frameworks) for building REST APIs.
* Database: Experience with relational and non-relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB or equivalent); solid understanding of schema design, joins, indexing, and query optimization.

**Technical Skills — Distributed Systems & Reliability**

* Working knowledge of distributed systems concepts: service decomposition, consistency models, caching, queuing/messaging, and failure handling.
* Reliability engineering fundamentals: observability (logging, metrics, tracing), SLAs/SLOs, error budgets, and operational runbooks.
* Ability to reason about system design trade-offs and build scalable, resilient solutions under ambiguity.

**Soft Skills**

* Proactive communication — shares updates without being asked and flags blockers early.
* Asks the right questions — clarifies requirements upfront before jumping into implementation.

title: AI Engineer
description:
**About the role**

Hunar.ai is hiring an AI Engineer to build and improve our Voice AI pipeline: the system that listens, understands and speaks back to users in real time. You will spend most of your time on this pipeline, from speech recognition through language models to speech synthesis, and on the infrastructure that keeps it fast and reliable at scale.

This role suits an engineer with at least 3 years of experience who enjoys hard systems problems. Voice is unforgiving: a few hundred milliseconds of extra latency or a dropped connection is felt immediately by the user. You will own those trade-offs end to end.

**What you'll do**

- Design, build and maintain the real-time Voice AI pipeline: audio capture and streaming, voice activity detection, speech-to-text (ASR), LLM orchestration, and text-to-speech (TTS).

- Drive down end-to-end latency, including time to first audio byte, turn-taking and interruption (barge-in) handling, so conversations feel natural.

- Improve quality: transcription accuracy, response relevance and voice naturalness, measured with clear evaluation metrics and test sets.

- Architect services that scale to many concurrent real-time sessions, with sensible load balancing, autoscaling and graceful degradation.

- Design data models and storage for conversations, transcripts, session state and analytics, choosing the right database and caching strategy for each.

- Integrate and evaluate third-party and open-source ASR, LLM and TTS models, and make build-versus-buy decisions with cost and latency in mind.

- Own reliability in production: monitoring, alerting, tracing, incident response and post-incident fixes.

- Work closely with product, research and infrastructure teams, and write clear design documents for the systems you build.

**What we're looking for**

- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience building and running backend or ML systems in production.

- Strong system design skills: you can design a distributed, low-latency service, explain its trade-offs and defend your choices.

- Hands-on experience scaling systems: horizontal scaling, load balancing, caching, queues and asynchronous processing, rate limiting and capacity planning.

- Solid database fundamentals: relational and NoSQL data modelling, indexing, query optimisation, transactions and isolation levels, replication, sharding and consistency trade-offs.

- Proficiency in Python. Knowledge of Go will be a bonus.

- Experience with real-time or streaming communication, such as WebSockets, gRPC streaming or event-driven architectures.

- Practical experience integrating ML or LLM models into production applications, including prompt design, evaluation and cost control.

- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure), containers and Kubernetes, and CI/CD.

- Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort owning ambiguous problems end to end.

**Nice to have**

A very big bonus: familiarity with running open-source models (ASR, LLM or TTS) on GPUs, such as self-hosting and serving them with tools like vLLM, TensorRT-LLM or Triton, and managing GPU capacity and cost.

**Also valued:**

- Experience building or operating voice AI in production systems, such as voice agents, contact-centre automation or voice assistants.

- Hands-on work with ASR and TTS models or providers (for example Whisper, Deepgram, ElevenLabs or similar), including fine-tuning or custom vocabularies.

- Knowledge of audio fundamentals: codecs, sample rates, jitter buffers, echo cancellation and noise suppression.

- Experience with WebRTC, SIP or telephony integrations.

- Experience optimising model inference: GPU serving, batching, quantisation or streaming inference.

- Experience with multilingual speech, accents or code-switching.

- Contributions to open-source speech or LLM tooling.

**Role details**

| Location | Bangalore |

| Employment type | Full-time |

| Experience | 3+ years |

To apply, send your CV and a short note about a system you designed or scaled that you're proud of to shantanu@hunar.ai, or apply directly using the link below:

title: Research Engineer
description:
**About the role**

Hunar.ai is hiring a Research Engineer to turn the latest AI advances, especially in voice AI, into faster and cost-effective systems for our product. You will track what is new, decide what matters for Hunar.ai, and prove or disprove it with quick proofs of concept.

A major focus is optimising the performance and cost of our voice AI pipeline using open-source models. Typical questions you might answer: which caching techniques cut latency and spend the most, and how our decision models should work. Speed matters here: we want ideas validated or discarded in days, not months.

**What you'll do**

- Stay on top of advances in AI relevant to Hunar.ai, especially voice AI: new ASR, LLM, TTS and speech-to-speech models, papers, inference techniques and tooling.

- Filter the noise: assess which advances could improve our product, and share concise write-ups and recommendations with the team.

- Optimise the performance and cost of our voice AI pipeline using open-source models, targeting latency, quality and cost per conversation.

- Research and design how our decision models should work, for example routing between models, turn-taking and intent decisions, and when to use a small versus a large model.

- Benchmark open-source models against commercial APIs on accuracy, latency and cost, using realistic test sets from our domain.

- Run fast proofs of concept to validate or discard ideas, with clear success criteria and measured results.

- Hand off successful POCs to the engineering team with enough documentation and code to take them to production.

What we're looking for

- 2+ years of experience in ML engineering, applied research or a closely related role.

- A track record of reading research papers and turning them into working code quickly.

- Hands-on experience running and evaluating open-source models (for example Llama, Qwen, Mistral, Whisper or open TTS models) on your own GPU setup.

- Experience with model serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM or Triton.

- Rigorous experimental habits: clear hypotheses, sound benchmarks, honest reporting of negative results.

- A bias for speed: you can scope a POC, build it in days and decide whether to continue or stop.

- Clear communication, so non-researchers can act on your findings.

**Nice to have**

- Experience with voice AI pipelines in production: ASR, TTS, voice activity detection, turn-taking or speech-to-speech models.

- Strong understanding of inference optimisation: quantisation, batching, KV caching, speculative decoding and streaming inference.

- Experience fine-tuning or distilling models, including LoRA and other parameter-efficient methods.

- Experience designing routing or cascade systems that pick the right model per request.

- Familiarity with evaluation of speech systems, such as word error rate, MOS and latency metrics like time to first audio.

- Experience with multilingual or Indic-language speech and text models.

- Publications, open-source contributions or public write-ups on ML topics.

**Role details**

Location - Bangalore

Employment type - Full-time

Experience - 2+ years

Apply here: https://apply.hunar.ai/job/35jkpftr?utm=jq\_af

You can aslo send your CV and a link to a POC, write-up or repo that shows how you test ideas quickly to shantanu@hunar.ai

title: AI Architect
description:
**About the Company:**

Rakuten India is the Development Centre and key technology hub of the Rakuten Group, Inc. We enable our businesses with our depth of knowledge in multiple streams of technology such as Mobile and Web Development, Web Analytics, Platform Development, Backend Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence and much more. Our unique 24/7 support center ensures reliability and sustenance of the Rakuten Ecosystem. With dedicated centres of excellence for Mobile Application Development, Data Analytics, Engineering, DevOps and Information Security, we ensure the success of multiple units of Rakuten Group, Inc. With 1700+ employees and growing, Rakuten India is housed in Crimson House Bangalore in the heart of the city.

**About Rakuten's BSS Engineering Team:**

Rakuten is at the forefront of innovation, and our in-house BSS engineering team is driving the future of telecommunications and digital services. We operate a cutting-edge, cloud-native microservices-based BSS platform serving both B2B and B2C customers globally. Our ambitious vision is to achieve
**Agentic SDLC**
and
**Agentic BSS**
, transforming our entire value chain through intelligent, autonomous agents. We're looking for a visionary and hands-on AI Architect to lead this charge.

**The Opportunity:**

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of how we build, deploy, and operate our mission-critical BSS platform. You will be instrumental in designing and implementing the architecture for our next generation of AI-powered autonomous agents, driving efficiency, innovation, and agility across our Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Business Support Systems (BSS). While BSS domain knowledge is a plus, your deep expertise in AI/ML, distributed systems, and a hands-on approach are paramount.

**What You'll Do:**

As our AI Architect (Agentic Systems), you will:

* **Architect Agentic Systems:**
  Design end-to-end architectures for intelligent agents that automate complex tasks within our SDLC (e.g., code generation, testing, deployment, security) and BSS (e.g., order fulfillment, customer support, service assurance, billing).
* **Drive Strategy & Roadmap:**
  Lead the technical strategy and roadmap for our Agentic SDLC and Agentic BSS initiatives, translating business needs into actionable AI/ML solutions.
* **Hands-on Prototyping & Development:**
  Be a hands-on contributor, developing proof-of-concepts, building core agent components, and guiding the implementation of AI solutions. You won't just design; you'll build.
* **LLM & AI Model Integration:**
  Architect the integration and orchestration of various AI models, including Large Language Models (LLMs) like Claude Code, Codex, and potentially open-source alternatives, into our agentic frameworks.
* **Data & MLOps Infrastructure:**
  Design and implement robust data pipelines, feature stores, and MLOps practices essential for agent training, deployment, monitoring, and continuous learning within our cloud-native environment.
* **Microservices & Cloud-Native Integration:**
  Ensure seamless integration of agentic systems with our existing cloud-native microservices architecture, leveraging Kubernetes, service meshes, and event-driven patterns.
* **Define Agent Interaction & Collaboration:**
  Design how agents interact with each other, with human users, and with external systems, focusing on robust communication protocols, feedback mechanisms, and human-in-the-loop processes.
* **Performance & Scalability:**
  Ensure agentic solutions are designed for high performance, scalability, and reliability in a production environment serving millions of B2B and B2C customers.
* **Security, Governance & Ethics:**
  Incorporate security best practices, data privacy, and ethical AI principles into the design and implementation of all agentic systems.
* **Mentor & Evangelize:**
  Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and foster a culture of AI-driven innovation within the engineering team. Evangelize the vision and benefits of agentic systems across the organization.

**What We're Looking For:**

* **8+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 3-5 years in a dedicated AI/ML Architect or Lead ML Engineer role.**
* **Deep hands-on expertise in designing, building, and deploying complex AI/ML systems into production.**
* **Proficiency in Python and relevant AI/ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).**
* **Extensive experience with Large Language Models (LLMs):**
  Understanding of LLM architectures, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and integrating LLMs via APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini) or open-source models.
* **Proven experience with agentic frameworks or multi-agent systems (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom implementations).**
  Demonstrated ability to build and orchestrate autonomous agents.
* **Strong understanding and hands-on experience with Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) automation tools and practices:**
  Including Git, CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, Argo CD), static code analysis, and automated testing frameworks.
* **Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures:**
  Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, microservices, APIs, and event-driven systems (e.g., Kafka) in a major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure).
* **Experience with MLOps principles and tools:**
  Model versioning, CI/CD for ML, monitoring, data pipelines for ML workflows.
* **Proven ability to architect and implement robust, scalable, and secure distributed systems.**
* **Excellent problem-solving skills, with a pragmatic and outcome-oriented approach.**
* **Strong communication and collaboration skills:**
  Ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences and work effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves):**

* Experience in the BSS (Business Support Systems) or telecommunications domain.
* Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or relevant publications.

*“Rakuten is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and connectedness. We are able to grow and learn better together with a diverse team and inclusive workforce. The collective sum of the individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression, and talent that our employees invest in their work represents not only part of our culture, but our reputation and Rakuten’s achievement as well. In recruiting for our team, we welcome the unique contributions that you can bring in terms of their education, opinions, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, veteran’s status, color, religion, disability, sexual orientation and beliefs”*

**Job Description**

* We are seeking a Senior Principal Engineer to build the AI-native capabilities that replace how security work is performed today.
* Security processes today run across multiple functional teams, frequently duplicated with different tooling and different definitions of done. This role re-engineers and implements the rationalized version of those processes as AI-native workflows, working from an approved solution design and directly with the teams whose work is being agentified.
* The expectation is production-grade engineering. Systems are delivered tested, instrumented so that the agent operations team can monitor them, and documented sufficiently for another engineer to extend them. Defects found in production are resolved by this role at root cause.

**Objectives of This Role**

* Cross-functional security workflows delivered as working AI-native implementations that replace the manual and fragmented processes they came from
* One implementation serving every function that shares a process, preserving in the build the consolidation the design sets out
* Delivery on committed timelines, with the reliability, observability, and cost profile to run in production
* Reusable components and patterns, so each workflow after the first starts from existing code

**Roles And Responsibilities**
  
  

* 12+ years in software engineering with direct ownership of systems in production
* Agentic systems you personally built and shipped into production, not prototypes, notebooks, or proofs of concept
* Strong programming proficiency in Python and at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or an equivalent language, with demonstrable code quality practice covering testing, review, refactoring, and maintainability
* Hands-on implementation experience across:

+ Agent loops and tool calling: loop control, sub-agent delegation, state management and checkpointing, and idempotent handling of consequential actions
+ Context engineering: retrieval and search, memory, grounding in enterprise data, prompt assembly, and structured or schema-constrained output
+ Testing and validation: automated tests for behavior that varies between runs, regression suites, and validation against defined acceptance criteria
+ Cost and latency engineering: token accounting, prompt and response caching, model routing with fallback, and context compaction

* Process re-engineering experience: analyzing an existing workflow and rebuilding it around what automation makes possible, rather than encoding current practice into software
* Experience replacing an existing manual or fragmented business process with software, working directly with the people who perform that process today
* Integration engineering: REST and GraphQL APIs, event-driven consumers, OAuth and scoped credential handling, schema and contract versioning, and resilient behavior under partial failure

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

* Work directly with the functional owners and practitioners whose process is being agentified to establish the operational detail a solution design does not carry: real data sources, exception paths, edge cases, and current decision logic
* Re-engineer the process as part of implementing it, rather than reproducing it step for step: remove steps that exist only because the work was performed by hand, collapse handoffs and queues, and restructure sequence and timing where agentic execution changes what is possible

Software Engineer I, AI Engineering (AIDLC)

* Delighting our customers and maintaining customer relationships are top priority and they work to always deliver solutions through this lens

* Ability to collaborate across organizational boundaries, build relationships, and achieve broader organizational goals.

title: Conversation AI Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Conversation AI Specialist who builds agentic, process-aligned dialogue systems — not scripted chatbots. You will build the conversational intelligence layer of our advisor efficiency platform. It includes timely orchestration, intent reasoning, and LLM-powered assist systems that help advisors during complex customer interactions across chat, phone, and ecommerce. You will own the full conversation stack, from utterance to action.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Agentic Conversation Design: Architect and build the conversational layer of our prompt-based agentic platform — including intent detection, dialogue orchestration, and multi-step reasoning flows aligned to advisor workflows.
* LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering: Design and maintain the prompt architecture that drives advisor-assist features — including context injection, tool-calling patterns, guardrails, and output validation.
* Advisor Assist Systems: Build real-time AI tools that surface relevant knowledge, suggest responses, and guide advisors through commerce, subscription, and support interactions.
* Process Mapping: Work with operations and product teams to deeply understand advisor business processes, then translate that understanding into conversation system design.
* Evaluation & Quality: Define conversation quality metrics, build evaluation datasets from real interaction logs, and operate a continuous improvement loop for deployed systems.
* Probabilistic Fallback Design: Design graceful degradation patterns — ensuring the system handles low-confidence states, ambiguous intents, and out-of-scope inputs without advisor disruption.
* Cross-platform Delivery: Integrate conversational AI features throughout chat, phone, and ecommerce advisor surfaces — maintaining coherent behavior across channels.

**Attitude & Approach We're Hiring For**
Beyond technical skills, we are specifically hiring for three attitude shifts that define success in this role:
  
  

* Process-aligned composition: you build conversation flows that mirror advisor operational workflows — not abstract dialogue trees disconnected from how work actually happens.
* Probabilistic reasoning: you architect systems where intent is inferred, confidence is tracked, and ambiguity is handled gracefully rather than failing hard.
* Data-driven iteration: you measure conversation quality with data, not intuition — defining metrics, curating evaluation sets, and iterating based on evidence.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3–5 years in conversational AI, NLP engineering, or LLM-based product development.
* Experience building dialogue systems with real business process alignment, not just scripted flows.
* Proficiency in Python and NLP tooling
* Strong understanding of intent classification, entity extraction, and context management in stateful conversations.
* Experience deploying conversational AI to production with real user traffic.
* Ability to build for uncertainty — confidence scoring, fallback handling, human-in-the-loop blocking issue.

* Experience building agentic systems with tool use, function calling, or multi-step LLM orchestration. Familiarity with RAG for knowledge-grounded responses.

You will collaborate closely with software engineers and investment servicing business teams to solve complex business challenges in the payments domain.

You will design data products, orchestrate multi-agent workflows, develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, integrate enterprise knowledge sources, and establish the governance and observability capabilities required to operate AI safely within a highly regulated financial services environment.
  
  
State Street is accelerating the adoption of AI-enabled capabilities to improve operational efficiency, enhance cybersecurity resilience, strengthen risk management, and deliver intelligent experiences across the enterprise.

****What You Will Be Responsible For****

* Design, build, and operationalize AI/ML solutions to detect anomalies, exceptions, fraud indicators, operational risk signals, and process deviations across high-volume payment flows.
* Develop anomaly detection models using supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised, time-series, graph-based, statistical, and hybrid machine learning approaches.
* Engineer features from payment transactions, exception events, operational logs, historical patterns, and reference data to identify unusual value, volume, velocity, counterparty, timing, currency, geography, and repair/reject behaviors.
* Build scalable batch, streaming, and near-real-time data pipelines to support payment monitoring, detection, scoring, alert generation, and downstream investigation workflows.
* Tune detection thresholds, scoring logic, and model sensitivity to balance early detection, precision, recall, false positive reduction, and operational usability.
* Develop explainability capabilities, reason codes, model diagnostics, and investigation summaries to help payment operations, risk, and technology teams understand why anomalies are flagged.
* Integrate anomaly detection services with payment applications, case management tools, workflow platforms, APIs, data stores, and human-in-the-loop review processes.
* Use GenAI, RAG, and agentic AI capabilities selectively to support alert summarization, root-cause analysis, knowledge retrieval, operational playbooks, and assisted triage.
* Implement MLOps practices for experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment automation, reproducibility, monitoring, rollback, and production support.
* Monitor model performance, alert quality, drift, data quality, investigation outcomes, SLA adherence, and production reliability across anomaly detection use cases.
* Partner with payments operations, product, risk, compliance, architecture, cybersecurity, and engineering teams to translate business scenarios into detection patterns and AI-enabled controls.
* Apply Responsible AI, model risk management, auditability, data governance, security, and regulatory control requirements for AI solutions in a financial services environment.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify AI use cases and translate business requirements into agent-based solutions.

****Education & Qualifications****
**Skills Required**

* Hands-on experience building anomaly detection, fraud detection, transaction monitoring, risk scoring, or payment intelligence models using supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised, and hybrid approaches.
* Strong understanding of anomaly detection techniques such as clustering, isolation forests, one-class SVM, autoencoders, gradient boosting, time-series anomaly detection, graph-based detection, and statistical outlier methods.
* Ability to engineer features from high-volume payment data, including amount, currency, value date, settlement date, counterparty, account, geography, payment type, frequency, velocity, historical behavior, exception codes, and repair/reject patterns.
* Experience tuning detection thresholds and model sensitivity to optimize precision, recall, F1 score, alert quality, false positive reduction, and operational triage effectiveness.
* Knowledge of payment flows, payment exceptions, duplicate payments, unusual value or volume patterns, payment repairs, rejects, sanctions referrals, cut-off breaches, and operational risk indicators.
* Experience deploying batch, streaming, or near-real-time inference pipelines using technologies such as Kafka, Spark, Airflow, cloud data platforms, APIs, and MLOps tooling.
* Ability to implement explainability and investigation support using SHAP, LIME, reason codes, model diagnostics, rule-model hybrids, and GenAI-assisted alert summarization.
* Experience monitoring model drift, data quality, alert trends, investigation outcomes, SLA performance, and production reliability for anomaly detection systems.

****Minimum Qualifications****

* 6+ years of professional experience; Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, AI/ML or related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in Data Engineering, AI Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering, Software Engineering, or related disciplines.
* Strong experience developing large-scale data pipelines and distributed data-processing solutions.
* Proficiency in Python with solid software engineering fundamentals
* Experience with SQL, APIs, workflow automation, and cloud-native architectures.
* Solid understanding of RAG, experience with OpenAI Service and prompt engineering techniques. Knowledge of vector databases.
* Experience integrating LLMs with external databases, APIs and storage systems
* Experience in CI/CD-based projects. Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes for deploying AI services

This is a hands-on technical role, not a management one: you'll set direction and raise the bar through writing code, leading experiments, writing documentation, and mentorship of team members for a platform that spans multiple agentic capabilities (knowledge & reasoning, tool use and orchestration, evaluation, and safety/guardrails) and which is used by many product teams across the business.
  
  
You should bring experience from multiple agentic AI projects with a similar order of complexity in terms of the technical challenges you have successfully tackled, together with a ‘sixth sense’ for agentic AI operation to predict the approaches which are likely yield successful results as the platform grows into new domains.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Go deep on the hardest technical problems inside the agentic AI platform - the ones where progress depends on specialist expertise, not just engineering effort: data discovery & consolidation, agent planning and tool-use, retrieval and grounding, validation-before-action, conflict/ambiguity handling, and similar hard sub-problems.
* Personally design, build, and harden the platform's most technically demanding components - the pieces where correctness, edge cases, and failure modes are subtle enough to need deep, hands-on ownership rather than delegation.
* Act as the team's go-to technical expert on agentic AI and LLM systems: the person others bring their hardest "how do we actually make this work" problems to, providing depth on specific technical questions rather than setting overall team direction.
* Diagnose and resolve the platform's toughest technical issues - performance, reliability, correctness, and edge-case failures - where specialist knowledge is the difference between a real fix and a workaround.
* Contribute into architecture discussions, stress-testing designs against hard technical realities (scaling limits, failure modes, subtle correctness issues) that come from real specialist experience.
* Evaluate emerging techniques, frameworks, and tools in agentic AI and LLM tooling, and give the team pragmatic, evidence-based recommendations on what's worth adopting.
* Write technical deep-dives and documentation that make complex mechanisms legible to the rest of the team, so your expertise compounds rather than staying tacit.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production systems in Python, TypeScript, Java, or a similar language.
* 10+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial time as a senior/staff/principal-level individual contributor architecting and operating production agentic AI systems involving multi-step reasoning, tool use, planning, or orchestration, where alignment and dependability of the agent’s output is a key success factor.
* Experience across multiple distinct agentic AI projects, able to draw on that breadth to guide technical decisions in unfamiliar contexts.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in: LLM agent frameworks and orchestration, tool-calling and validation-before-action patterns, RAG and retrieval architecture, evaluation and observability for AI systems.
* A track record of setting technical direction and shaping outcomes across teams without formal management authority.
* Sound engineering judgement on production concerns at platform scale: reliability, security, multi-tenancy, performance, and observability for services consumed by many internal teams.
* Excellent technical communication - able to write RFCs and architectural documents that align diverse stakeholders, and to move fluently between deeply technical and business audiences.
* Comfort operating with significant ambiguity and autonomy, including defining the right problem as much as solving it.
* Undergraduate, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

**Preferred Experience**

* Public technical-leadership signals: conference talks, published papers or blog posts, significant open-source contributions, or patents in AI/agentic systems.
* Semantic and symbolic tooling (RDF/OWL, SHACL, Datalog, DMN, production rule engines, policy-as-code) as one of several tools in a broader agentic toolkit.
* Experience in high-accountability, regulated domains (pharmaceutical or food labelling, legal technology, financial services) or the packaging/graphic arts industry.
* Experience scaling an AI or data platform from a handful of internal consumers to many, including the governance and support model that requires.

**What Success Looks Like**

* The platform's hardest technical problems get solved correctly and durably.
* The team turns to you as the deep technical authority on agentic AI and LLM systems - for the "how" and "why it breaks,".
* The components you build are robust, well-tested, and well-documented, with edge cases and failure modes properly accounted for rather than discovered in production.
* Your specialist expertise ends up embedded in the platform itself - in code, designs, and documentation - not just in advice given in meetings, and also reflected in growing knowledge and capabilities of more junior team members.
* Emerging techniques and tools get properly evaluated on their technical merits, so adoption decisions are grounded in real hands-on assessment rather than hype.
* Agents built on components you own reliably apply the correct context, explain their reasoning, justify / evidence actions, and escalate rather than guess when evidence is ambiguous or absent.

Esko is proud to part of the Product Quality & Innovation segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto’s vibrant global network of 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment
*where purpose meets possibility*
: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you’ll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we’re Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™—and building rewarding careers along the way.
  
  
At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. title: Lead AI Forward Engineer
description:
The Lead AI Forward Engineer designs and guides the delivery of AI-powered solutions that reduce operational toil and accelerate technology teams across the CIO organization. This role operates as a forward-deployed solution architect and engineer, partnering closely with teams to identify opportunities, design end-to-end architectures, and drive implementations to production.
  
  
You will own solution design from concept through deployment, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and extensible. You will evaluate emerging AI technologies, define repeatable patterns, and help build new capabilities through hands-on implementation, mentorship, and shared standards.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Solution Architecture and Delivery**

* Identify high-impact opportunities to apply AI automation and intelligent agents across CIO technology teams.
* Design end-to-end AI solutions, including workflows, integration patterns, data flows, and operational considerations.
* Guide implementation from prototype to production, ensuring solutions meet reliability, security, and compliance expectations.
* Define reusable architectural patterns and reference designs to enable broader adoption across teams.
* Build scalable pipelines to collect and analyze inference‑ and workflow‑level telemetry, integrating with TR's data backbone.
* Develop dashboards and reports providing clear visibility into performance, reliability, safety, and cost.
* Ensure compliance with TR's AI standards for monitoring, governance, privacy, and auditability.

**AI System Design and Technology Strategy**

* Evaluate and recommend AI/ML technologies and platforms (LLM orchestration, agentic frameworks, cloud AI services) based on capability, cost, risk, and fit.
* Design flexible architectures that can evolve with model/provider changes and emerging AI capabilities.
* Apply sound judgment on when AI is appropriate vs. when simpler automation or traditional engineering approaches are better.
* Establish and track SLOs/SLIs for critical AI services to meet enterprise reliability and compliance requirements.
* Integrate AI observability tooling into CI/CD so new models, prompts, and workflows are automatically enrolled in monitoring and evaluation.
* Develop automated guardrails and policy enforcement (e.g., limits, anomaly detection, abuse/failure pattern detection) with cloud engineering and security teams.

**Cross Functional Partnership and Influence**

* Partner with engineering teams, service owners, and stakeholders to translate business needs into technical requirements and solution designs.
* Communicate trade-offs and design decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership when needed.
* Mentor engineers and share patterns, practices, and lessons learned to raise overall AI solution design maturity.
* Partner with Product, Data Science and AI teams to design and run evaluation frameworks for LLMs/ML models (offline/online tests, benchmarks, canaries, A/B experiments).
* Work with Product, Data Science, AI Inference Engineering, and Enterprise AI teams to onboard new AI use cases into the observability platform from day one.
* Collaborate with Cloud Engineers (AWS, Azure and GCP) and SREs to align AI observability with broader platform observability and capacity management.
* Support scaling and monitoring of AI infrastructure and workloads during major releases and global events.

**Technical Skills**
**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong solution design/architecture capability: end-to-end system design, integration patterns, API thinking, and operational design.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML and LLM application patterns, including:

+ LLM capabilities/limitations, prompt design, orchestration approaches, and agent workflows
+ Practical trade-offs (latency, quality, cost, safety, reliability)
+ Production AI systems and observability challenges (prompting, context windows, RAG, hallucinations, provider variability).

* Proficiency in Python (strongly preferred) and ability to prototype and validate designs with hands-on technical work.
* Cloud architecture familiarity in AWS, Azure, or GCP, including common service patterns and enterprise constraints.
* Knowledge of distributed systems, microservices, CI/CD, and cloud‑native architectures.
* Strong communication skills: ability to document designs, influence decisions, and align diverse stakeholders.

**About You**
**Preferred Background**

* 10+ years of experience with progression in solution architecture, technical strategy, or senior engineering roles.
* Experience building software prototypes and taking solutions to production in ambiguous, low-precedent environments.
* Familiarity with LLM frameworks and patterns (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), RAG/vector search concepts, and enterprise integration considerations.
* Experience with DevOps/Platform Engineering/SRE principles and designing for operational excellence.
* Exposure to enterprise service management (e.g., ServiceNow/ITSM), security architecture, and compliance-oriented environments.
* Demonstrated technical leadership through mentoring, architectural governance, or cross-team enablement.

**What’s in it For You?**

* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Suffolk is privately held and is led by founder, chairman and CEO John Fish. Suffolk is ranked #8 on ENR’s list of “Top CM-at-Risk Contractors.”

**About Suffolk Global:**

Suffolk Global is a strategic extension of Suffolk Construction, established to unlock the full potential of a globally integrated delivery model. Based in Bangalore, India, Suffolk Global brings together world-class talent, advanced technology, and innovative processes to enhance how Suffolk designs, plans, and builds.

As a critical part of Suffolk’s long-term growth strategy, Suffolk Global enables greater speed, scalability, and technical rigor across the business. At the intersection of process standardization, AI-enabled innovation, and global talent, Suffolk Global is redefining how work is executed , embedding consistent workflows, leveraging technology to drive efficiency, and building high-performing teams aligned to Suffolk’s evolving needs.

By embedding deeply with U.S.-based teams, the platform supports high-impact work across design, digital delivery, and corporate functions. Powered by India’s exceptional talent pool, Suffolk Global is building a next-generation capability that combines deep technical expertise with a relentless focus on quality, efficiency, and continuous innovation, helping redefine what’s possible in the built environment.

**About Artificial Intelligence (AI):**

Suffolk’s AI team is at the forefront of redefining how AI transforms the built environment. Operating as a core part of Suffolk’s global innovation ecosystem, the team works at the intersection of construction, technology, and advanced analytics to design and deploy AI-driven solutions that address real-world challenges across jobsites and enterprise functions.

The work spans a broad range of IT capabilities, including enterprise applications, end-user support, systems integration, and platform delivery. The team helps ensure seamless connectivity across systems, reliable day-to-day operations, and a strong foundation for continued digital growth across the business.

This is an opportunity to build and scale cutting-edge AI capabilities in a highly applied environment, while helping shape Suffolk’s vision for the ‘Construction Site of the Future’ and redefining what’s possible in the built environment.

**Overview:**

Build and operate reusable AI infrastructure services that enable teams to develop, deploy, and scale Agentic AI and Generative AI applications securely and reliably.

This role focuses on building foundational AI platform capabilities including LLMOps, observability, governance, guardrails, retrieval systems, orchestration frameworks, and runtime infrastructure for autonomous AI agents.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build AI Infrastructure to support a team of Agentic and GenAI app developers. This including building systems for Guardrails, Observability, Governance, LLMOps, agent to agent orchestration, Traceability and other such infra elements that are unique to AI systems. This includes the following…
* Build and maintain the foundational infrastructure for agentic AI systems — including orchestration layers, tool registries, and execution environments that support multi-step, autonomous agent workflows
* Design reliable and observable agent runtimes — implement tracing, logging, and replay tooling across long-running agent sessions, with support for interrupt/resume, sandboxing, and failure recovery (e.g. LangSmith, Arize, custom OpenTelemetry pipelines)
* Own memory and context infrastructure — architect short- and long-term memory stores, manage context window strategies, and build retrieval systems that give agents reliable, low-latency access to the right information at the right time
* Develop and operate tool/API integration layers — build secure, rate-limit-aware, and schema-validated connectors that agents use to interact with external systems, ensuring safe and auditable tool execution
* Define guardrails and safety infrastructure for autonomous agents\*— implement policy enforcement, output validation, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and permission scoping to ensure agents operate within defined boundaries in production

**Qualifications:**

**Experience:**

* 10 -15 years software engineering
* 8-10 developing ML/AI systems

**What “Good” Looks Like;**

**Can independently build:**

* A retrieval pipeline
* A simple eval framework
* A production-ready API

**Competencies:**

* Engineering fundamentals
* Learning agility
* System reliability mindset

* Technical Ownership: Ability to own complex AI platforms end to end, from problem framing and architecture through delivery, monitoring, optimization, and continuous improvement.

title: Lead Research Engineer - LLM Optimization & Agentic Systems
description:
**Company:**
CraftifAI

**Work arrangement:**
Full-time, work from office

**Role focus:**
70% hands-on research and engineering; 30% technical leadership and ownership

**Preferred joining timeline:**
Candidates who can join in fewer than 45 days are preferred.

About CraftifAI

CraftifAI is building
**Orbit**
, a platform that automates engineering workflows across embedded software, Edge AI, and FPGA development. Our work connects requirements, domain knowledge, code generation, testing, validation, and deployment to help engineering teams build working products.

We are looking for a research-driven engineer who can strengthen the LLMs and agentic systems behind these workflows, with a particular focus on efficient on-premises deployment and reliable code generation.

About the Role

You will lead the research and implementation of domain-specific LLM solutions and agentic systems for engineering applications. This includes fine-tuning models, reducing their deployment footprint while preserving measured task quality, designing knowledge architectures, building agent harnesses, and establishing rigorous product benchmarks.

This is a
**hands-on technical leadership role**
. Approximately 70% of your time will involve coding, experiments, model optimization, evaluation, and product integration. The remaining 30% will involve architecture decisions, research direction, mentoring, and ownership of technical outcomes.

You should be comfortable moving from a research hypothesis to an implementation, measuring its impact, understanding its failures, and improving it until it works reliably within the product.

What You Will Own

1. LLM Fine-Tuning and Efficient On-Premises Deployment

* Adapt LLMs for engineering tasks, including code generation, tool use, debugging, and reasoning over domain-specific information.
* Build data preparation and fine-tuning workflows using suitable approaches such as supervised fine-tuning, LoRA, QLoRA, and preference optimization.
* Apply and evaluate compression techniques such as quantization, knowledge distillation, and pruning to reduce model size and memory requirements.
* Measure trade-offs between task quality, model footprint, inference latency, throughput, and infrastructure cost on target deployment hardware.

2. Agentic Systems for Code Generation

* Design and implement agent harnesses for task planning, repository exploration, context management, code generation, tool execution, debugging, and iterative correction.
* Build reliable execution flows with clear state management, failure recovery, stopping conditions, and observable results.
* Improve the ability of agents to complete engineering tasks across multiple files, dependencies, tools, and execution environments.
* Own the integration of these capabilities into CraftifAI’s product workflows.

3. Domain Knowledge and Context Architecture

* Design knowledge systems that connect source code, requirements, architecture documents, hardware documentation, SDKs, APIs, and previous engineering outcomes.
* Develop effective retrieval and context construction using approaches such as hybrid search, reranking, structured knowledge, and repository-aware retrieval.
* Decide when information belongs in model training, retrieval, structured tools, or persistent agent memory.
* Keep retrieved information traceable to its source, version, and applicable hardware or software configuration.

4. Code Quality and Automated Verification

* Build and integrate static analysis tools, compiler diagnostics, linters, code structure checks, and security checks into agent workflows.
* Combine these checks with automated builds, unit tests, and controlled execution to evaluate generated code.
* Convert tool findings into actionable feedback that agents can use to diagnose and correct their outputs.
* Establish quality gates and regression checks that provide objective evidence of improvement.

5. Low-Latency System Design

* Profile and optimize the complete workflow, including retrieval, context preparation, model inference, tool calls, and correction cycles.
* Improve serving, caching, batching, context efficiency, and execution routing where they produce measurable benefits.
* Design for practical on-premises constraints, including available compute, GPU memory, concurrency, and restricted external connectivity.
* Optimize time to a verified result alongside model response time.

6. Reasoning and Learning from Field Use

* Improve agent planning, tool selection, debugging, and recovery through systematic failure analysis and controlled experiments.
* Turn field failures and user feedback into curated datasets, evaluation cases, improved knowledge, and better agent behavior.
* Evaluate suitable methods for improving reasoning and tool use, including fine-tuning, preference learning, and reinforcement learning where appropriate.
* Validate improvements against regression benchmarks before release, within customer data and deployment constraints.

7. Product Benchmarking and Technical Leadership

* Own reproducible benchmarks at both model and complete product workflow levels.
* Measure task completion, functional correctness, static analysis findings, test results, human intervention, latency, memory use, and compute cost.
* Use held-out tasks, baseline comparisons, ablation studies, and error analysis to explain which changes improve the product and why.
* Define research priorities, lead architecture and code reviews, mentor engineers, and take ownership from experimentation through product integration.

Required Qualifications and Experience

* **Minimum qualification: MS by Research from a Tier-1 institution in India or abroad**
  , in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a closely related field.
  **A PhD is preferred.**
* Strong practical experience fine-tuning LLMs and deploying them on private or on-premises infrastructure.
* Demonstrated experience reducing model size or inference memory requirements, supported by measured quality and performance results.
* Deep hands-on experience building agentic systems for code generation, including tool integration, execution feedback, and iterative repair.
* Strong understanding of domain knowledge architecture, retrieval systems, context management, and their interaction with model behavior.
* Strong Python and software engineering skills, with practical experience using frameworks such as PyTorch, Transformers, PEFT, or equivalent tools.
* Experience integrating static analysis, build systems, automated testing, or other programmatic checks into code-generation workflows.
* Strong research discipline: clear hypotheses, controlled experiments, reproducible results, and careful interpretation of failures.
* Ability to make architecture decisions, communicate technical trade-offs, and personally implement critical parts of the solution.

Additional Experience We Value

* Research publications or open-source contributions in efficient LLMs, code models, reasoning, agentic systems, or program analysis.
* Experience with C/C++, embedded software, compilers, firmware, or hardware-aware code generation.
* Experience with model serving, inference profiling, distributed training, or resource-constrained deployments.
* Experience turning research prototypes into maintained production capabilities.

What to Include in Your Application

Please share your CV and relevant publications, repositories, or project examples. Where possible, include:

* An LLM fine-tuning or compression project with measured quality, memory, and latency results.
* An agentic code-generation system you personally built, including its tool integrations and evaluation approach.
* A brief explanation of your individual contribution and the most significant technical problem you solved.
* Your current notice period and availability to work from the office.

Our platform enables fintechs, banks, consumer brands, and digital businesses to seamlessly embed travel into their products through APIs, SDKs, and intelligent infrastructure.

We’re building towards a future where travel is embedded everywhere, increasingly autonomous, and powered by AI.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an exceptionally resourceful, technically strong, and hands-on individual to join our Founder’s Office – Engineering.

Think of this role as being the CTO’s technical right hand.

You’ll work closely with the CTO across engineering initiatives, new product ideas, architecture, AI experimentation, internal tooling, and strategic technical projects.

You’ll also act as a trusted liaison between the CTO and engineering teams, product stakeholders, technology partners, and external collaborators.

But here’s the important part: This is a hands-on engineering role, not a project management or coordination role.

We want someone who can write code, build prototypes, investigate problems, understand complex systems, challenge technical decisions, and independently take projects from an idea to a working solution.

One day you could be building an AI agent. The next, exploring a new backend architecture, debugging an integration, or representing the CTO in a technical discussion.

You’ll be involved in both the thinking and the doing.

**What You’ll Do**

**1. Build, Code & Experiment**

\* Write production-quality code and build working prototypes.

\* Personally own and deliver engineering projects from concept to deployment.

\* Build internal tools, developer utilities, automations, and AI-powered workflows.

\* Experiment with LLMs, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, and emerging technologies.

\* Work across APIs, backend systems, integrations, SDKs, and occasionally frontend applications.

\* Debug complex technical problems, investigate issues, and propose practical solutions.

\* Use modern AI coding tools to accelerate development and experimentation.
